jobs.description:
Brailsford \& Dunlavey (B\&D), which now includes Project Management Advisors (PMA), is seeking a Project Manager to join our team in San Francisco


This is a hybrid role based in San Francisco, CA.


**The Opportunity**


An opportunity for a driven project management professional who thrives in fast\-paced environments, enjoys collaborating with innovative clients and project teams, and is motivated to deliver complex facilities and real estate projects that enable growth, innovation, and operational excellence.


At Brailsford \& Dunlavey (B\&D), we lead the planning, development, and management of the places that shape and strengthen communities—where people live, learn, work, and innovate. B\&D partners with institutions, municipalities, and organizations to deliver complex real estate and capital projects through strategic advisory and program management services across the full project lifecycle.


B\&D recently joined forces with Project Management Advisors (PMA), bringing together two nationally recognized leaders in program management and real estate advisory services. Together, the combined firm offers expanded capabilities across industries and end\-to\-end project delivery—from early\-stage strategy through design, construction, and occupancy.


As a Project Manager, you will lead planning, entitlement, design, and construction activities for complex development and capital projects, working closely with clients, architects, engineers, contractors, consultants, and public agencies. Projects may include site and infrastructure improvements, park and public realm development, and new building construction. You will help navigate entitlement and approval processes, coordinate multidisciplinary teams, and drive projects from early planning through successful delivery.


**How You'll Contribute**


* Serve as the primary liaison between clients and project teams throughout the full project lifecycle
* Manage planning, design, and construction activities primarily for Life Science projects
* Review and evaluate project requirements to ensure alignment with business objectives and client goals
* Develop, monitor, and maintain project budgets, schedules, and reporting tools
* Analyze project costs, schedules, and risks to support informed decision\-making
* Coordinate procurement of design, construction, and consultant services
* Support contract development, negotiation, review, and administration
* Oversee the development and review of architectural and engineering drawings and bid documents
* Facilitate project meetings, document action items, and drive accountability across stakeholders
* Engage with clients, architects, engineers, contractors, consultants, and local agencies to communicate project status and resolve issues
* Evaluate potential budget and schedule impacts and recommend mitigation strategies
* Lead value engineering discussions and review alternative solutions with project teams
* Coordinate specialty consultants and peer reviews as required
* Provide guidance and support to Assistant Project Managers and junior team members
* Monitor construction activities to ensure compliance with project requirements, schedules, and quality standards
* Support contract issuance, purchase orders, and progress payment reviews
* Observe and report on construction progress, risks, and field conditions
* Manage project closeout activities and successful turnover to clients
* Participate in business development initiatives, networking opportunities, proposals, and client presentations


**What We're Looking For**


* 5\+ years of project management, development, or construction management experience
* Bachelor's degree in Architecture, Engineering, Construction Management, Real Estate, Urban Planning, or a related field
* Demonstrated success delivering projects while meeting client expectations, schedules, and budgets
* Strong understanding of design, construction, and project management processes
* Experience managing budgets, schedules, contracts, and project controls
* Ability to interpret architectural and engineering documentation
* Strong communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills
* Experience coordinating multidisciplinary project teams
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic, client\-focused environment


**What Sets You Apart**


* Experience with Life Science projects and/or MEP systems
* You are a proactive self\-starter who takes ownership and drives results
* You excel at building strong relationships with clients and project stakeholders
* You bring strong emotional intelligence and communication skills to every interaction
* You are highly organized and detail\-oriented when managing complex projects
* You approach challenges with curiosity, creativity, and a solutions\-oriented mindset
* You thrive in fast\-paced environments and can adapt to changing priorities
* You demonstrate professionalism, integrity, and sound judgment
* You are motivated by helping clients create innovative environments that support growth and success
* You are interested in mentoring others and contributing to the growth of the team

**The Opportunity**
-------------------


We are seeking an experienced project management professional to support a globally recognized technology client across a complex portfolio of workplace, tenant improvement, renovation, relocation, and capital projects.


The ideal candidate brings significant experience managing corporate workplace and tenant improvement projects and is comfortable working in complex, fast\-paced environments with multiple stakeholders and concurrent projects. This individual will work closely with client leadership, workplace and facilities teams, architects, engineers, contractors, consultants, and other project partners to deliver high\-quality projects that align with business, operational, and workplace objectives.

**Project Manager**
===================

  

**Date:** Sep 22, 2026


**Location:** San Jose, California, United States


**Company:** Super Micro Computer


**Job Req ID: 30148**
---------------------


**About Supermicro:**
---------------------


Supermicro® is a Top Tier provider of advanced server, storage, and networking solutions for Data Center, Cloud Computing, Enterprise IT, Hadoop/ Big Data, Hyperscale, HPC and IoT/Embedded customers worldwide. We are the \#5 fastest growing company among the Silicon Valley Top 50 technology firms. Our unprecedented global expansion has provided us with the opportunity to offer a large number of new positions to the technology community. We seek talented, passionate, and committed engineers, technologists, and business leaders to join us.  

  



**Job Summary:**
----------------


Supermicro is seeking a Project Manager to lead and scale Salesforce\-driven service operations initiatives across global teams. This role will serve as the operational bridge between business shareholders, Salesforce administrators, external development and vendor partners, and IT system owners.

  

  

The ideal candidate combines structured project leadership with hands\-on coordination across Salesforce, system integration (APIs), and service operations workflows. This individual will drive execution across development cycles, incident management, backlog prioritization, and cross\-system automation efforts. This role is remote across California, Arizona, Texas, Colorado, Nevada, or Utah.


**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**
------------------------------------------


**Includes the following essential duties and responsibilities (other duties may also be assigned):**
  

* Lead daily Salesforce development standups and end\-of\-day review sessions.
* Coordinate development lifecycle across Dev, UAT, and Production environments.
* Maintain and continuously prioritize the Salesforce Master Backlog.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to drive execution, resolve challenges, and ensure timely project delivery.
* Facilitate communication between global teams, ensuring seamless project execution across regions.
* Utilize project management tools such as JIRA, Smartsheet, Microsoft Project, Team, Slack, etc. to track progress and report updates.
* Ensure QA validation and user acceptance criteria are met prior to release.
* Partner with external development vendors (e.g., offshore teams) to drive delivery and remove blockers.
* Lead coordination of API integration efforts between Salesforce and enterprise systems.

**Other Responsibilities:**
  

* Drive structural backlog grooming and prioritization across projects, incidents, and enhancements.
* Identify automation opportunities to reduce manual effort and improve operational efficiencies.
* Partner with IT and system owners to define integration architecture and automation strategy.
* Facilitate cross\-functional requirements gathering sessions.

**Qualifications:**
-------------------


* 5\+ years of experience in managing project management, preferably in Salesforce or enterprise SaaS platform initiatives.
* Experience leading Dev UAT Production release cycles.
* Strong experience with MS Office suite, and Smartsheet.
* Strong understanding of API integrations and cross\-system architecture.
* Experience working with offshore development partners.
* Familiarity with Service Cloud or enterprise ticketing systems is strongly preferred.
* Salesforce certifications (Admin, Developer, etc.) or ability to obtain in 30\-60 days from hire
* Ability to travel domestically and internationally as needed.


**Salary Range**
----------------


$120,000 \- $140,000


The salary offered will depend on several factors, including your location, level, education, training, specific skills, years of experience, and comparison to other employees already in this role. In addition to a comprehensive benefits package, candidates may be eligible for other forms of compensation, such as participation in bonus and equity award programs.

jobs.title: Program Manager, Growth, Monetization & Strategic Initiatives
jobs.description:
From Fivetran's founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We're proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data\-driven.

  

**About Us**  

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry\-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.  

  

Together, we're delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.  

  

Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.  

  

As we bring our teams and technology together, we're building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It's an exciting time to join us: we're creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.  

  

During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

  


**About the Role**
------------------



Fivetran is building data pipelines to power the modern data stack for thousands of companies.

  



We're looking for a **Program Manager** to serve as the operational backbone of our pricing and monetization strategy in addition to supporting strategic initiatives, as needed. Sitting within Product Program Management and partnering closely with Analytics, Product, Sales, Product Marketing, RevOps, Finance, and Engineering, you'll own the cross\-functional execution that turns pricing strategy into well\-governed, shipped programs. You'll coordinate launches end to end, track commitments, resolve escalations, and expand the playbook that makes growth at Fivetran repeatable and scalable. This is a high\-visibility role for someone who thrives at the intersection of program management, GTM, and product strategy. You will be driving some of the most impactful business outcomes.

  



This is a full\-time, hybrid position based out of our Oakland, CA or Denver, CO office. Our hybrid work model offers a blend of remote flexibility and in\-person collaboration, including two days in the office each week to connect and build as a team.

  


**Technologies You'll Use**
---------------------------



Google Workspace(sheets)/Excel, Jira, Looker/Sigma/Hex, Notion, Salesforce and Slack.

  


**What You'll Do**
------------------


* Drive program governance, including running various meetings and decision\-making cadences.


* Lead Growth \& Monetization planning in close partnership with Sales \& Engineering leadership.


* Track program deliverables and commitments end to end.


* Coordinate engineering timelines, dependencies, and launch readiness with the ePMO.


* Partner with Product Marketing and RevOps on enablement plans and rollout execution.


* Manage sales escalations and the cross\-functional coordination required to resolve them.


* Partner with Finance and Analytics on analyses and ad hoc business metric requests from stakeholders across the organization.


* Report on outcomes, such as closed\-lost\-due\-to\-pricing and overall pricing impact.


* Expand upon and further operationalize Fivetran's pricing and program management playbooks.

  


**Skills We're Looking For**
----------------------------


* Proven experience in program management or product operations, ideally supporting pricing, monetization, or GTM initiative in B2B SaaS and with consumption based pricing.


* A track record of driving cross\-functional execution across Product, Sales, Marketing, and Engineering.


* Excellent stakeholder management and executive communication, including tracking and reporting on commitments to senior leadership.


* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret pricing and revenue data and translate it into clear insights and recommendations.


* Experience establishing operating rhythms, governance processes, and repeatable playbooks.


* Familiarity with GTM and RevOps tooling and processes (e.g., Salesforce, CPQ, and BI tools such as Looker).


* Highly organized and self\-directed, able to manage multiple concurrent programs in a fast\-paced environment.

  


**Bonus Skills**
----------------

* Experience in data processing (ETL, ELT) and/or cloud\-based platforms


* PMP Certified



\#LI\-HYBRID

  

**Perks and Benefits**


* 100% employer\-paid medical insurance**\***
* Generous paid time away from work, including paid vacation or flexible/unlimited vacation depending on role and country, plus paid sick time, inclusive parental leave, paid holidays, including a year\-end Global Week of Rest, and volunteer days off.
* RSU stock grants\*
* Professional development and training opportunities
* Company virtual happy hours, free food, and fun team\-building activities
* Monthly cell phone stipend
* Access to an innovative mental health support platform that offers personalized care and resources in areas such as: therapy, coaching, and self\-guided mindfulness exercises for all covered employees and their covered dependents.


* *May vary by country and worker type \- please reach out to your recruiter for more information*


*Click* *here* *to learn more about Fivetran's Benefits by Region.*



We're honored to be valued at over $5\.6 bil

Wipro Limited (NYSE: WIT, BSE: 507685, NSE: WIPRO) is a leading technology services and consulting company focused on building innovative solutions that address clients’ most complex digital transformation needs. Leveraging our holistic portfolio of capabilities in consulting, design, engineering, and operations, we help clients realize their boldest ambitions and build future\-ready, sustainable businesses. With over 230,000 employees and business partners across 65 countries, we deliver on the promise of helping our customers, colleagues, and communities thrive in an ever\-changing world. For additional information, visit us at www.wipro.com.  

Quick Turn Program Manager


We are looking for a Quick Turn Program Manager (QTPM) to join QTPM Execution team. Our work has a major impact across all functional areas. We need passionate, hard\-working, and creative people to help us reach our Speed of Light (SOL) goals.

  

What you will be doing:


* Drive Speed of Light (SOL) execution at Contract Manufacturers (CM) to deliver zero manufacturing defects for New Product Introduction (NPI) boards and systems assemblies. Work with cross\-functional teams to support local Quick Turn (QT) and Mass Production (MP) products and handle all aspects of board and system assemblies.
* Champion continuous improvement at the CM to reduce waste.
* Be the primary Operations subject matter expert to drive CM readiness and prepare for production ramp or new product launch. Drive execution to higher operational efficiency and improve daily going rate (DGR), to achieve quality standard and reliable delivery for boards \& system assemblies.
* Coordinates resource, prioritizes activities, and establishes schedules to complete assignments. Responsible for clear to build and build schedule. Manage multiple QT/MP/Rework/RMA Builds locally and overseas (CM).
* Attend daily WIP Call with the factory. Provide daily communication and status to Board Program Manager (BPM) or Requestors.
* Initiate Special Build Instructions, coordinate ECOs and confirm updates after BOM comparisons are complete. Provide shipment ETA, tracking information to BPM/requestors, and closely monitors Critical Shipments.
* Conduct Control Run Readiness Reviews and Manage Control Run Builds. Coordinate board test for CM. Follow up with BPM/LDE for test diagnostics \& Vbios, works with SQE/CM for test results. Feedback any failures to LDE/BPM.
* Lead regular reviews and ensure all risks associated with the product are identified and closed or mitigated to enable the quality ramp of a product. Managing all operational issues; advancing key issues and present options for resolution to the cross\-functional teams.
* Create \& Issue Supplier Corrective Action Request (SCAR) \& drive closure, as needed. Reviewing all open 8D, during weekly Quality \& On Time Deliver (OTD) critical metric meetings. Maintain asset \& equipment lists, Bi\-weekly asset cycle verification

* 7\+ years of working experience in the Contract Manufacturing or Production planning field.
* Bachelor of Science degree in Operations, Manufacturing Management, Logistics or related fields, or equivalent experience.
* Must function independently in a multifaceted and fast paced environment.
* Ability to take ownership of tasks, to resolve time sensitive issues in a dynamic production environment.
* Very strong leadership, facilitation, problem solving, and project management skills are required to be successful in this role. Strong interpersonal skills, enjoy working with others in a collaborative, social environment; effective at building and maintaining strong relationships.
* Be solution driven. Apply problem solving skills to work through conflict in an effective and professional manner to maintain productive working relationships.
* Proficiency in business software applications such as Microsoft Office, Excel, SAP, MRP – Excellent analytical skills and hands\-on with excel to analyze data \- formulas, pivot tables. Ability to write excels macros is a plus.
* Language: Excellent English skills on reading, writing, speaking, and listening

* APICS, Six Sigma, Lean Manufacturing certification is helpful.
* Flexibility and willingness to travel as the need arise.

jobs.title: Life Sciences - Reinvention Program Manager
jobs.description:
We are:


Accenture helps the world's leading enterprises reinvent by building their digital core and unleashing the power of AI to create value at speed and scale. We are a talent\- and innovation\-led company with approximately 799,000 people serving clients in more than 120 countries.

  

Accenture's Life Sciences Reinventive Enterprise practice leads AI\-driven enterprise transformation at the world's leading pharmaceutical and biotechnology organizations. We deploy the Reinvention Force: a human \+ AI team of Transformers, Workforce Architects, and AI \& Data Innovators that makes reinvention real at enterprise scale.

  

This is a high\-visibility, high\-impact practice with strong momentum and a clear path to Managing Director for high performers.

  

About the role:

* The Reinvention Program Manager is the operational backbone of the AI Transformation Office.
* This role keeps the program running with discipline, visibility, and momentum — managing communications, milestone tracking, portfolio reporting, and operating cadence across all workstreams.
* This is not a traditional PMO role — it is an AI\-enabled program manager who uses automation to do what once required a team.

  

The Work:

* Manage project communications, milestone tracking, and portfolio reporting across all transformation workstreams — giving the Portfolio Strategy \& Value Lead the visibility needed to govern effectively
* Track budget actuals against plan, surface variances early, and support governance reporting to the client's transformation leadership
* Leverage AI\-powered project management tools and automation to streamline program operations — this role is expected to be a practitioner of the tools deployed
* Coordinate across Transformers, Workforce Architects, and AI \& Data Innovators to maintain an integrated view of progress, dependencies, and risks
* Maintain the operating cadence: cadence calls, status reports, risk logs, and action tracking across a fast\-moving transformation engagement

  

You are:


An experienced practitioner with proven delivery expertise in your domain. You are analytically rigorous and structured in your thinking. You communicate complex ideas clearly to senior stakeholders. You are comfortable operating in ambiguous environments and thrive in cross\-functional delivery teams. You have supported business development and are ready to take on more. You bring intellectual curiosity, drive, and a genuine interest in how AI is transforming the Life Sciences industry.


  

Candidates must have at least 5 years of combined experience in the following areas:

  

* Program or project management at a top\-tier consulting firm or in a complex enterprise delivery environment, with demonstrated experience managing multi\-workstream programs from initiation through completion.
* A proven track record designing and maintaining program operating rhythms — including cadence calls, status reporting, risk logs, and budget tracking — for senior executive audiences.
* Experience leveraging AI\-powered project management and automation tools to improve program visibility and reduce manual effort.
* Strong executive\-ready written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to synthesize complex program status into clear, decision\-ready materials.
* Experience coordinating across multidisciplinary teams including consultants, technologists, and change practitioners.
* Willingness and ability to travel domestically and internationally as client and business needs require.

  

Preferred skills/experience:

  

* MBA or advanced degree in a relevant discipline.
* PMP, Agile/Scrum (CSM, SAFe), or equivalent program management certification.
* Experience managing AI\-enabled transformation programs or enterprise change initiatives in Life Sciences.
* Familiarity with AI agent orchestration tools for program reporting, status automation, or backlog management.
* Track record at a top\-tier consulting firm managing large\-scale transformation program delivery across multiple simultaneous workstreams.

  

Compensation at Accenture varies depending on a wide array of factors, which may include but are not limited to the specific office location, role, skill set, and level of experience. As required by local law, Accenture provides a reasonable range of compensation for roles that may be hired as set forth below.

Accenture helps the world's leading enterprises reinvent by building their digital core and unleashing the power of AI to create value at speed and scale. We are a talent\- and innovation\-led company with approximately 799,000 people serving clients in more than 120 countries.

  

Accenture's Life Sciences Reinventive Enterprise practice leads AI\-driven enterprise transformation at the world's leading pharmaceutical and biotechnology organizations. We deploy the Reinvention Force: a human \+ AI team of Transformers, Workforce Architects, and AI \& Data Innovators that makes reinvention real at enterprise scale.

  

This is a high\-visibility, high\-impact practice with strong momentum and a clear path to Managing Director for high performers.

  

About the role:

* The Reinvention Program Manager is the operational backbone of the AI Transformation Office.
* This role keeps the program running with discipline, visibility, and momentum — managing communications, milestone tracking, portfolio reporting, and operating cadence across all workstreams.

An experienced practitioner with proven delivery expertise in your domain. You are analytically rigorous and structured in your thinking. You communicate complex ideas clearly to senior stakeholders. jobs.title: Staff Program Manager: Customer Success
jobs.description:
**Overview**
------------


Join Intuit as a **Staff** **Program Manager** on the Customer Success team. This is a high\-impact role for someone who enjoys building structure, driving execution, and turning complex ideas into clear, actionable programs.


In this role, you’ll help design and run cross\-functional programs that support our global customer base. You’ll work in ambiguous spaces, partner closely with product, operations, and go\-to\-market teams, and bring order, clarity, and momentum to important initiatives. You’ll be responsible for coordinating work across teams, tracking progress, surfacing risks, and ensuring programs move forward efficiently and deliver meaningful outcomes.

  

This role requires strong operational fundamentals, clear communication, and the ability to manage multiple workstreams at once. You’ll regularly present updates and recommendations to stakeholders, collaborate with senior leaders, and help translate strategy into execution.

 **Responsibilities**

**Program Design \& Launch:** Support the design and launch of cross\-functional programs, helping define scope, milestones, ownership, and success metrics aligned to Customer Success and GBSG goals.

**Coordinate \& Execute:** Drive day\-to\-day execution by organizing workstreams, maintaining operating rhythms, and ensuring teams stay aligned, informed, and unblocked.

**Operational Excellence:** Track progress, manage dependencies and risks, and use data to keep programs on track and delivering measurable results for customers.

**Stakeholder Partnership:** Partner with product, engineering, marketing, and operations teams to align priorities, clarify expectations, and move work forward.

**Clear Communication:** Deliver concise, relevant updates to stakeholders, clearly outlining status, risks, decisions needed, and next steps.

**Decision Support:** Help identify trade\-offs, prepare recommendations, and escalate issues when needed with clear context and data.

 **Adapt \& Improve:** Anticipate challenges, adjust plans as needed, and continuously improve processes to increase team efficiency and program impact.

 **Qualifications**

* **7\+ years** of experience supporting or leading cross\-functional programs in a SaaS or technology environment.
* Experience working in ambiguous problem spaces and helping bring structure, clarity, and momentum to new initiatives.
* Strong program management fundamentals, including planning, execution tracking, risk management, and stakeholder coordination.
* Data\-driven mindset with the ability to use metrics to inform decisions and communicate progress and risks.
* Comfortable managing up and across teams, with experience presenting updates and recommendations to senior stakeholders.
* Ability to operate at both the strategic level (understanding goals and priorities) and the tactical level (driving day\-to\-day execution).
* Clear, effective communicator across written and verbal formats.
* Strong collaborator who can influence without authority and build trust across teams.
* Passion for customer success and delivering real, measurable impact.

  

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers \| Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.


The expected base pay range for this position is:
  

San Diego $150,000 \- $203,000

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
Requisition ID \# 170610
  
  

**Job Category:** Project / Program Management
  
**Job Level:** Individual Contributor
  
**Business Unit:** Energy Delivery
  
**Work Type:** Hybrid
  
**Job Location:** San Ramon
  
  

Department Overview
  
  

Engineering, Planning \& Strategy will play a leading role in showing California and the world how PG\&E will meet California’s decarbonization and resilience goals while improving safety, affordability and reliability. The Large Load Project Management Team is responsible for delivering complex, high\-capacity electric infrastructure projects that support major commercial and industrial customers. These projects often involve multi\-phase transmission and distribution upgrades, regulatory compliance, and coordination with internal and external stakeholders to meet customer timelines and strategic commitments.
  
  

Position Summary
  
  

This job is represented by Engineers and Scientists of California (ESC) subject to collective bargaining.
  
  

This position, under general direction, exercises judgment and discretion and is responsible for all aspects of the development and implementation of assigned projects and provides a single point of contact for those projects. Project duration is generally multi\-year, requires significant risk management, and may include formal partnering agreements with outside firms. Assignments will have high visibility, require extensive project management skills and often require specific discipline and areas of expertise, such as:
  
  

Electric transmission substation projects
  
Electric transmission line projects
  
  

This position is hybrid, working from your remote office and your assigned work location based on business need.
  
  

PG\&E is providing the salary range that the company in good faith believes it might pay for this position at the time of the job posting. This compensation range is specific to the locality of the job. The actual salary paid to an individual will be based on multiple factors, including, but not limited to, specific skills, education, licenses or certifications, experience, market value, geographic location, collective bargaining agreements, and internal equity. Although we estimate the successful candidate hired into this role will be placed towards the middle or entry point of the range, the decision will be made on a case\-by\-case basis related to these factors.
  
  

**The salary range is:**  

CA Minimum, $161,520
  
CA Maximum, $207,504
  
  

Job Responsibilities
  
  

Provides leadership, coaching, technical direction, and oversight for assigned projects; also provides knowledge transfer and assistance to many technical and/or project management employees and teams.
  
Proactively controls the scope, schedule, cost, and quality of a large portfolio of projects throughout the project life cycle.
  
Provides extensive knowledge and guidance to others in start\-up testing, inspections, and condition assessment; actively supports complex and/or large project start\-up tests and field inspections.
  
Provides guidance to engineering on producing complex risk and alternative analyses, studies and conceptual designs for presentation to project sponsors and/or leadership.
  
Oversees and administrates EPC contracts.
  
Negotiates third party contracts, in support of other departments when appropriate.
  
Makes presentations to PG\&E Officers as appropriate.
  
Arbitrates and resolves conflicts within the project.
  
Mentors and provides guidance to less experienced project managers.
  
  

Qualifications
  
  

**Minimum:**  

Bachelor’s degree (BA/BS) from an accredited college\*
  
8 years of PG\&E (9 years outside) of relevant experience in electric, gas, or power generation operations, engineering, business planning, accounting, finance, construction management, or project management
  
Active Project Management Professional (PMP) certification
  
  

* In lieu of a four (4\) year degree, candidates may qualify with twelve (12\) or more years of directly related work experience in areas such as accounting, engineering, construction management, project scheduling, or project controls, with responsibilities comparable to those outlined for this role. External hires must have a minimum of thirteen (13\) years of applicable experience.


**Desired:**  

Electrical Engineering Degree for the Substation projects and Civil Engineering for Transmission line projects
  
Knowledge of and experience with electric substations, and transmission line projects
  
Fluent in the use of Project Management tools and current company tools, such as SAP Financials and Work Management modules and Microsoft Project Scheduling Software
  
Superior ability to interface with and across supporting organizations and conduct formal presentations to officers.
  
Knowledge of land acquisition, CPUC and environmental permitting, and EPC contracting procedures.
  
Demonstrated ability to lead multiple medium to large scale complex projects; provide resolution of complex technical and/or contractual issues; and/or provide Project Management on multiple projects with complex scope requiring non\-standard approaches; without supervision.
  
Demonstrated application of extensive project management skills, including seasoned and experience\-based judgment and organizational business acumen in applying and adapting traditional project management techniques.
  
Demonstrates extensive contracting knowledge and contract negotiation and management skills.
  
Demonstrates excellent verbal and written communication skills, utilizes a variety of styles to connect with the intended audience, and able to present complex information to upper management on a variety of topics.
  
Builds consensus around complex and controversial project \& technical issues.
  
Demonstrated high quality work by self and others on project team.

Marcom is the creatively\-led global team that oversees Apple’s consumer facing marketing. We ensure the flawless development and execution of world\-class communications across all medias and platforms. Every day, hundreds of millions of Apple customers around the world interact with our products. We drive the strategy and creative work that provide both new and existing customers with simple, engaging and inspiring marketing experiences.  

  

Sr. Program Manager of Marketing Systems leads the operational execution, management, and governance of the critical digital frameworks and initiatives that define Interactive’s global presence. This role is a strategic lead accountable for ensuring that complex digital programs, ranging from design systems to marketing platform optimizations, are delivered with operational rigor and measurable outcomes, while partnering closely with engineering to deliver scalable, performant solutions.  

  

**Description**  

  

The role serves as a primary connective node between Design, Engineering, and Product, driving shared accountability, removing systemic blockers, and ensuring cross\-functional alignment at every stage of delivery. This includes partnering across product management and engineering to ensure business needs are met, from operational Worldwide (WW) workflow definition and optimization, to contributing into measurement frameworks that track go\-to\-market (GTM) velocity and program impact. The role operates with discretion, managing large\-scale initiatives and regularly engaging senior leadership to drive the evolution of digital transformation.

Define and maintain the operational cadence, including stand\-ups, planning sessions, retrospectives, and milestone reviews; ensuring consistency and accountability across all work\-streams.  

  

Identify and eliminate recurring process bottlenecks through root\-cause analysis, implementing systemic fixes rather than one\-off workarounds.  

  

Facilitate trade\-offs between bespoke creative expression and scalable system reuse, guiding teams toward decisions that balance creative excellence with operational efficiency.

Background working with or alongside design systems teams (contribution models, governance, adoption metrics).

jobs.title: ASO Readiness Program Manager
jobs.description:
Imagine what you could do here! The people here at Apple don’t just create products \- they build the kind of wonder that’s revolutionized entire industries. It’s the diversity of those people and their ideas that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do, from amazing technology to industry\-leading environmental efforts. At Apple, inclusion is a shared responsibility, and we work together to foster a culture where everyone belongs and is inspired to do their best work.  

  

Here on the Apple Store Online team, we are responsible for Apple’s largest store. Our main goal is to deliver a magical, personal digital experience where customers can shop, buy and learn everything Apple, wherever they are. Each customer should feel like they are our only customer and our job is to set the bar for the experience they receive. To run such an extraordinary store, it takes extraordinary people, and we are looking for someone to help us do extraordinary things.

jobs.title: Patient Experience Coordinator / Lead Chiropractic Assistant
jobs.description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for a warm, organized, high\-ownership Patient Experience Coordinator / Lead Chiropractic Assistant to help create an exceptional patient experience while keeping the front end of our practice running smoothly.

This role is highly patient\-facing and directly impacts the health of the practice.

You will help manage the patient journey from the first phone call through active care, making sure leads are followed up with, schedules stay full, patients feel cared for, and important details do not fall through the cracks.

We are looking for someone who is naturally outgoing and personable, but also organized, proactive, and dependable.

As the practice grows, there is opportunity to take on more responsibility in systems, operations, and team leadership.

**What You’ll Own**

* Greet patients and create a warm, welcoming experience
* Check patients in and keep clinic flow organized
* Answer phone calls and respond to patient texts
* Schedule appointments and care plans
* Collect payments and help maintain accurate accounts
* Follow up with new leads quickly and consistently
* Help convert inquiries into scheduled new\-patient appointments
* Manage confirmations, cancellations, no\-shows, and rescheduling
* Keep patients prebooked and engaged in their care
* Follow up with patients who fall off schedule
* Run reactivation lists and outreach
* Support CMR scheduling and coordination
* Help coordinate clinic events and patient campaigns
* All scans from start to finish
* Preparing patients for scans
* Making sure scans are completed on time
* Making sure scan results are organized and ready for you
* Tracking who is due for a scan or rescan
* Maintain accurate patient information and front\-desk systems
* Notice problems, communicate them early, and help create solutions
* Help improve front\-desk processes as the practice grows

**What Success Looks Like**

You are doing well in this role when:

* Patients feel known, welcomed, and cared for
* Leads are followed up with consistently
* New patients get scheduled quickly
* The schedule is organized and well managed
* Cancellations and no\-shows are followed up on
* Patients stay engaged throughout their care
* Payments and communication are handled accurately
* Fewer opportunities are lost because someone forgot to follow up
* The front desk feels calm, organized, and proactive
* You can be trusted to own your responsibilities without being chased

**You’ll Be a Great Fit If You**

* Are naturally warm, friendly, and confident with people
* Have strong communication skills
* Are extremely organized
* Follow through without needing repeated reminders
* Can handle multiple priorities without becoming scattered
* Take ownership when something needs attention
* Notice details other people may miss
* Are comfortable making phone calls and following up with leads
* Enjoy helping people and building relationships
* Can receive feedback without becoming defensive
* Are willing to learn numbers and understand how your role impacts the practice
* Want to grow with a company rather than simply clock in and out

Experience in chiropractic, healthcare, hospitality, customer service, sales, or a busy front\-office environment is helpful, but attitude, ownership, and follow\-through matter most.

**This Role Probably Isn’t For You If**

* You dislike being on the phone
* Following up with leads feels uncomfortable to you
* You need someone to constantly remind you what to do
* You prefer waiting for instructions instead of taking initiative
* You struggle with organization or details
* You avoid direct feedback
* You become easily overwhelmed when several things happen at once
* You want a quiet administrative role with limited interaction
* You believe front desk means simply answering phones and checking people in

**Our Core Values**

This role lives these values in front of every family and every team member, every day.

Better People

We hire people we would fight to keep.

Character comes first. We take ownership, communicate directly, and make the person next to us better.

Earned Greatness

You bring your best when the day gets hard.

You do not wait for things to improve on their own. You get incrementally better on purpose and take pride in leaving the practice stronger than you found it.

Contagious Calm

Families borrow the nervous system of the room.

You are that room.

You stay present, organized, and confident even when the practice is busy.

**Growth Opportunity**

This role begins primarily focused on patient experience and front\-desk ownership.

As the practice grows, there is opportunity to expand into areas such as:

* Practice Manager
* Front\-desk leadership
* Training future team members
* KPI tracking
* Systems and process improvement
* Events and campaigns
* Practice operations

Growth in responsibility comes through ownership, results, consistency, and trust.

How to Apply

Please email your resume and answer the following question to drdanika@fikachiropractic.com. Only applications sent via email will be considered.

**If you ran the front desk at Fika, what's one thing you'd do in your first 30 days to improve how families experience our office?**

Pay: $24\.00 \- $27\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 28\.0 – 35\.0 per week

Work Location: In person

**Licensed Pharmacy Technician – Patient Care Coordinator (PCC)**


**Full\-Time \& Part\-Time Opportunities \| Oakland, CA**

  


**A clear and active California Pharmacy Technician license is required. Applicants without an active license cannot be considered.**

  


**Be Part of Our Growing Northern California Team**



Since 1989, MDR Pharmacy has helped patients across the nation on their journey to parenthood. What started as a small, family\-run pharmacy in Los Angeles has grown into one of the largest independently owned specialty fertility pharmacies in the U.S.



MDR opened its first Northern California location in Oakland earlier this year. This is an opportunity to join a growing team, support the continued development of our Oakland operations, and build a long\-term career in specialty pharmacy.

  


**About the Role**



The Patient Care Coordinator (PCC) is at the heart of our patient experience team. This position operates in a fast\-paced call center setting and serves as a point of contact for IVF clinics and patients. You’ll help ensure patients receive their fertility medications accurately, on time, and with compassion.



This role is a great opportunity for a licensed Pharmacy Technician who is:


* Reliable and comfortable in a busy, high\-energy environment


* Adaptable and ready to learn


* Empathetic and passionate about helping others


* Able to remain calm and professional during sensitive patient interactions

  


**What You’ll Do**


* Process prescriptions and accurately enter patient, medication, insurance, billing, and delivery information under a pharmacist’s supervision.


* Coordinate with patients and IVF clinics to ensure medication orders are accurate and delivered on time.


* Assist with insurance, billing, refill, and order issues, escalating clinical questions to the pharmacist when needed.


* Communicate with empathy and professionalism while protecting patient confidentiality.


* Collaborate with pharmacists, technicians, shipping, billing, and other departments to resolve issues efficiently.


* Manage multiple priorities using strong attention to detail, organization, and basic math skills.

  


**What We’re Looking For**


* Clear and active California Pharmacy Technician license in good standing — required


* Customer service or call center experience; pharmacy or healthcare experience is preferred


* Strong computer and basic math skills, including Word, Excel, and typing at least 45 WPM


* Excellent attention to detail with the ability to prioritize and multitask


* Reliable, on\-site availability for either a full\-time or part\-time schedule, including rotating weekends as scheduled


* Ability to maintain an active Pharmacy Technician license throughout employment

  


**What to Expect**


* High call volume and frequent multitasking


* A fast\-paced environment where accuracy matters


* Patients who may be emotional and need calm, supportive communication


* A collaborative team with present and supportive leadership

  


**Training and Growth**



Team members will attend a fully paid training program (5–10 business days) at our Los Angeles headquarters, with travel and lodging provided.



You will gain hands\-on experience in our established pharmacy operations before transitioning into your role at the Oakland location, giving you a strong foundation in patient care, workflow, and day\-to\-day pharmacy operations.



As part of your training, you will rotate through several departments at our Los Angeles headquarters, including the Front Pharmacy Clerk, Operators, and Shipping departments, before being paired with a Lead Patient Care Coordinator. This training will help you understand how each part of the pharmacy operates and how patient orders move through the process.



You will receive continuous guidance, feedback, and support as you grow into the Patient Care Coordinator role and contribute to MDR’s growing Northern California team.

  


**What We Offer**


* Career growth in a respected healthcare field


* Competitive pay


* Fully paid Los Angeles training with travel and lodging provided


* Medical, dental, and vision benefits


* 401(k)


* Paid vacation and holidays

jobs.description:
**Careers** **by** **E****mpowering Futures, Building Communities**

Imagine going to work each day knowing that your efforts positively impact individuals and communities. As a global movement and the nation's leading nonprofit organization dedicated to strengthening communities through youth development, healthy living, and social responsibility, the YMCA of Greater San Francisco offers more than just a job—we offer a career with a future and the opportunity to make a lasting difference in your community. At the Y, you can uncover your passion and build a lifelong career addressing some of the nation's most pressing social issues.  


**Our****Organizational** **Culture**

At the YMCA of Greater San Francisco, we are committed to demonstrating values that aim to building strong communities where you can **Be**, **Belong** and **Become.** With **Truth \& Courage**, we strive to understand and act on individual and societal truths. We ensure a safe and inclusive environment with **Authenticity \& Accessibility**, allowing everyone to participate according to their needs. Our approach is **Dependable \& Creative**, as we respond to community needs through strong partnerships. Above all, we embody **Dignity \& Empathy**, treating everyone with respect and compassion, and recognizing the inherent dignity in all individuals.

**Qualifications**

* 21\+ year old
* Associate’s degree or higher, or High School diploma/equivalent with one of the following:
	+ 48\+ completed college units (verified by transcript),
	+ Passing score on the CA Basic Education Skills Test (CBEST), or
	+ Passing score on a District Instructional Aide Exam.
* Strong teamwork and communication skills
* Knowledge of youth development principles.
* Available Monday–Friday during program hours (\~1:00–6:00 pm).

**Preferred** **Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in child development or related field.
* Experience working with elementary or middle school\-aged youth.
* Bilingual skills in Spanish, Cantonese, Mandarin, or other languages preferred but not required.
* Knowledge of arts, dance, drama, sports, or other enrichment areas.



**Position Summary**

The After School Program Leader provides meaningful opportunities for youth in YMCA programs at KIPP Middle School. They work under the supervision of Program Site Coordinators and Directors and are expected to demonstrate flexibility, initiative, and punctuality, with a commitment to the school\-year schedule.  

* 
**Job Responsibilities**

**Curriculum Development \& Program Delivery**

* Develop and implement engaging, inclusive, and theme\-based curricula tailored to the developmental and cultural needs of youth.
* Lead academic enrichment sessions, tutoring, and organized outdoor recreational activities.
* Collaborate with staff, parents, and participants to plan program activities.



**Supervision \& Safety**

* Supervise and support groups of up to 20 students, ensuring safety and compliance with YMCA and child\-safe protocols.
* Monitor participants, respond swiftly to critical incidents, and enforce safety regulations.



**Record\-Keeping \& Compliance**

* Maintain accurate program records, including attendance, emergency information, and safety logs.



**Communication \& Engagement**

* Communicate respectfully with participants, parents, staff, and volunteers.



**Training \& Development**

* Complete required safety and program training before the first shift and attend all mandatory meetings and training sessions.



**Work Environment \& Physical Demands**

The After School Program Leader works in a dynamic environment at local elementary or middle school sites, including indoor classrooms and outdoor schoolyards. The role involves frequent standing, walking, and active participation in physical activities such as recreational sports and games. The environment can be fast\-paced and loud, and the role may require occasional lifting of up to 20 pounds.  


**Disclaimers**

* All duties and responsibilities are essential job functions subject to reasonable accommodation. The YMCA of Greater San Francisco promotes an equal employment opportunity workplace, which includes reasonable accommodation for otherwise qualified disabled applicants and employees. Please contact your manager if you have any questions about this policy or these job duties.

**Salary Description**

The After School Program Leader \-KIPP Middle School position offers a compensation range of $24\.00 – $25\.50 per hour. This rate is based on salary benchmarking for similar roles and is aligned with grant fund approvals and requirements for the position.

* Establish clear objectives with accountability commitments.
* Direct special service operations events such as Service Challenge, area meetings, and Store of the Year.
* Communicate customer expectations and opportunities.

* Measure Market performance against plans and metrics.

**Qualifications**



Education Level: Bachelor’s degree in business, finance or related field and/or at least 5 years’ experience in retail store operations preferred.

Skills and Experiences


* Financial acumen and analytical skills combined with attention to detail.
* Thorough knowledge of front\-end work methods, fund handling, and scanning procedures.

Physical Environment

* Incumbent may sit for long periods at a desk or computer terminal.

Albertsons Companies' Northern California Market office is located in Pleasanton, CA and supports the operations of 285 retail stores across northern California, northwestern Nevada, and Hawaii under the Safeway, Andronico’s, Vons, and Pak ‘n Save Foods banners.

jobs.description:
Yowei Therapeutics and Yowei Oncology are stealth\-stage life\-sciences companies working closely with CSBio to advance peptide\-based clinical programs. Their work spans longevity and peptide therapeutics, clinical trials, evaluation of a 503A pharmacy model, personalized synthetic neoantigen peptide oncology programs, and supporting microbiology and laboratory capabilities. Together, they are building the clinical, pharmacy, data, laboratory, and operational infrastructure needed to responsibly translate peptide programs into patient\-facing studies and services. Both companies expect to remain in stealth through Q1 2027\.


CSBio is a peptide contract manufacturing founded in 1993\. CSBio initial products were a complete line of automated synthesizers for manufacturing and process development, with a focus on cGMP production. In 1994, CSBio opened a custom peptide facility and began producing high quality compounds for research organizations and pharmaceutical companies worldwide. In 2004, CSBio opened a peptide production facility in Menlo Park, CA and in 2014, CSBio expanded production capability through the addition of a new, state of the art building dedicated to cGMP peptide production. In 2017, CSBio passed a FDA inspection and were recommended to be approved for commercial drug substance manufacturing. In 2023, additional cGMP clinical production capacity was added in Milpitas, CA.


We are seeking qualified individuals to join us as Quality Assurance Specialist. Core duties and responsibilities include the following:


Job Duties:

* Support Quality Management System at CSBio encompassing quality investigations including Deviations, CAPAs, and oversee Document Control, Training and Customer Complaints.
* Provide direction, assess and remediate, as appropriate, current and previous validation documentation, including conducting gap assessments, risk assessments, and development of standards.
* Review/approve OOS, deviations, CAPAs, SOPs, and operation documents.

* Apply sound, systematic problem\-solving methodologies in identifying, prioritizing, communicating, and resolving quality issues.

* Identify and manage continuous improvement projects with the objective of achieving quality and efficiency in processes.

**About Handshake**
===================


Handshake was founded on a simple belief that everyone deserves a path to a great career, regardless of where they went to school or who they know. Today, we power 25 million job seekers, 1 million\+ employers, and 1,600 educational institutions.


In 2025, we started Handshake AI and built the fastest\-growing AI data business in history. We work directly with frontier AI lab researchers to create evaluations, publish benchmarks, and push the boundary of data. We’ve grown from $0 to \~$1B run rate and pay \~$60M to over 30K individuals every month.

**Why join Handshake now:**

* Shape how every career evolves in the AI economy, at global scale, with impact your friends, family and peers can see and feel
* Partner hand\-in\-hand with world\-class AI labs, Fortune 500 partners and the world’s top educational institutions
* Work together with engineers, scientists, operators, and more from Palantir, Meta, Scale AI, and former YC founders

**About the Role**
==================


Account Management at Handshake owns **Gross Revenue Retention (GRR), Net Revenue Retention (NRR), renewals, and expansion revenue** across our customer base.


As an **Account Manager, SMB / Mid\-Market**, you'll own the commercial relationship and growth strategy for a portfolio of approximately **75–130 customers**, acting as a strategic commercial owner rather than a contract\-execution renewal rep. You’ll be accountable for retaining and growing revenue while helping customers maximize the value of their partnership with Handshake.


You’ll partner closely with Customer Success, Sales, RevOps, Product, Support, Finance, and Legal to develop account strategies, mitigate risk, navigate complex customer needs, and identify opportunities to deepen and expand customer relationships.


This role is ideal for someone who enjoys balancing **strategic account management, consultative selling, customer advocacy, and operational rigor**. You’ll manage customers at different stages of their lifecycle and prioritize your time based on retention risk, expansion potential, and overall business impact.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**About Blockit**
-----------------


Blockit is a Sequoia\-backed AI time agent.


It learns your preferences and can autonomously coordinate meetings to any degree of complexity (timezones, group scheduling, IRL, etc) similar to an executive assistant – but never goes to sleep and responds instantly.


Blockit is the foundation of a massive platform of AI agents that will have access to the world's time. The more people who continue to link their calendars to the agent, the more powerful our network becomes.

**Role**
========


Blockit is seeking a Customer Success Manager to lead activation, adoption, and retention across our customer base. We're looking for someone with 3\+ years in customer success, account management, or solutions at a software company. Experience standing up a function rather than inheriting one is a plus.


You will personally work with every contracted account we have — today that's hundreds of accounts, heavily concentrated in venture capital, private equity, financial services, and professional services firms, alongside a fast\-growing base of AI and technology startups. You'll partner with our onboarding specialist to run pilots, fix problems, drive adoption, surface expansion signals for the rest of the GTM team, and be the voice that carries what they tell us back into the product.


Ideally, you are technical enough to figure out SSO or a broken calendar sync before you escalate it, commercially aware enough to recognize when an account is ready to grow, and analytical enough to write an SOP when a customer asks a usage question our dashboard can't answer yet. You are comfortable and excited by the speed of zero\-to\-one building in a startup environment and bonus points if you have a passion for productivity tools.


Our agent spreads virally, which means accounts land on you already curious and already using the product. Your job is to turn that curiosity into activated, deeply adopted teams — and to ensure the motion that lets the next ten people do it after you.

**What you'll do:**
-------------------

* Lead Enterprise onboarding, pilots, and rollouts end to end — setup, admin training, then adoption team by team: usage reviews with admins and chasing the pockets that haven’t linked calendars.
* Serve as the primary contact for inbound support and agent\-behavior feedback via email and Slack.
* Handle churn with a real save motion: understand why, offer the right landing spot, and harvest the reason.
* Build the machine: usage and retention reporting, templates, runbooks, and the QA loop behind our AI support agent.

**What success looks like:**
----------------------------

* **Accounts activate.** Within 90 days of close, most of an account’s users clear the value bar — five or more meetings scheduled. Account activation rate is the number you own.
* **Activation sticks.** Users hold that bar on a trailing 90\-day basis. First\-time activation is the start; sustained usage is the proof a team has actually changed how it schedules.
* **The product gets better.** A third of what customers write to us is a bug, a sixth a feature request. You turn that stream into prioritized input for product and engineering.

**Who you are:**
----------------

* 3\+ years in customer success, account management, or solutions. Founding or first\-CS\-hire experience is a strong plus.
* Technically curious and unafraid of the stack — you can hold your own with engineers.
* Comfortable with data and quick to learn. You know the difference between a number and a story.
* Commercially aware: you’ve read an account, known when it was ready to grow, and made the case with evidence rather than instinct.
* Exceptional writer — most of this job happens in email and Slack, in front of managing partners and heads of platform at some of the best firms in the world.
* Organized to a fault, with high agency and no ego about scope. Fifteen external calls, forty email threads, a bug queue, and a pilot scorecard only coexist if you have a system — and some weeks the job is a training session, some weeks a supplier registration portal at 9pm.
* Bonus: experience with horizontal productivity tools, or a network in venture capital, private equity, or professional services.

Working closely with the Director of Business Development, the Senior Account Manager will focus on developing high\-potential referral accounts, expanding existing partnerships, and building relationships with healthcare decision\-makers throughout the South Bay.

* Identify opportunities to increase referrals and admissions from existing accounts

* Meet established referral, admission, and account growth goals

**What You'll Need**
--------------------


* 3\+ years of healthcare sales, business development, account management, community relations, or related experience

* Strong relationship\-building, communication, presentation, negotiation, and follow\-up skills
* Self\-motivated and comfortable working independently in the field
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills
* Knowledge of the Santa Clara County healthcare market strongly preferred

* Valid California driver's license and driving record that meets company requirements

**Benefits**
------------


* Performance\-based bonus opportunity
* Company vehicle
* AI\-powered technology to support referral insights and efficient territory routing
* Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance
* 401(k) with company matching
* Paid time off

jobs.title: Therapeutic Account Manager, Liver - Palo Alto
jobs.description:
**MISSION**



Mirum Pharmaceuticals is a biopharmaceutical company dedicated to transforming the treatment of rare diseases. We are passionate about advancing scientific discoveries to become important medicines for rare disease patients. We are collaborative, creative, and experienced professionals and we're looking to augment our team with other individuals who embody our values: care, be real, get it done, and have fun, seriously.

**POSITION SUMMARY**



The Therapeutic Account Manager (TAM) is responsible for delivering strong, sustainable business performance and meaningful patient impact across an assigned territory. The TAM develops deep clinical and account expertise in rare cholestatic liver diseases and Mirum's Liver portfolio; identifies and prioritizes high\-opportunity customers, accounts, and referral networks; and executes customized account plans that advance disease awareness, appropriate patient identification, treatment consideration, initiation, and persistence in accordance with approved indications and promotional practices.



The ideal TAM is not a transactional seller. This individual is a clinically credible, insight\-led partner who engages healthcare professionals as a peer, asks thoughtful questions, constructively challenges clinical inertia, and influences change across complex accounts. The TAM works closely with the Regional Business Director and cross\-functional partners to connect customer needs, patient journeys, referral pathways, access dynamics, and business opportunities while demonstrating curiosity, high emotional intelligence, resilience, ownership, and consistent follow\-through.


**JOB FUNCTIONS/RESPONSIBILITIES**


**Territory Strategy \& Business Performance**


* Develop and execute a focused territory business plan aligned with national, zone, and regional priorities, with clear objectives, customer priorities, resource allocation, and measures of success.
* Use performance data, customer insights, market intelligence, access dynamics, and competitive trends to identify opportunities, anticipate barriers, and make timely adjustments to territory strategy and execution.
* Delivers territory business objectives through disciplined prioritization, high\-quality customer engagement, effective resource stewardship, and accountability for both behaviors and results.
* Maintain accurate and timely customer records, forecasts, expense reporting, required administrative documentation, and business updates in accordance with company expectations.


**Strategic Account Management \& Network Development**


* Identify, prioritize, and develop high\-opportunity accounts, health systems, centers of excellence, and referral networks across pediatric and adult hepatology and gastroenterology.
* Create and execute customized account plans that reflect the local patient journey, key stakeholders, clinical decision\-making, referral patterns, access considerations, customer needs, and competitive realities.
* Build trusted relationships with physicians, advanced practice providers, nurses, pharmacists, office staff, and other members of the care team by delivering relevant value and consistent follow\-through.
* Map influence and decision\-making within complex accounts, establish clear objectives for each engagement, and secure appropriate next steps that advance the account strategy.
* Coordinate compliant account actions across Mirum field partners, clarify ownership, and maintain momentum against agreed priorities and customer needs.


**Clinical Aptitude \& Customer Engagement**


* Develop and maintain deep knowledge of rare cholestatic liver disease, diagnostic pathways, mechanisms of action, clinical data, product profiles, approved uses, safety information, patient support pathways, access and reimbursement, and the evolving competitive landscape.
* Communicate complex scientific and clinical information clearly, accurately, and credibly, tailoring the discussion to the knowledge, needs, and priorities of each healthcare professional and account.
* Engage healthcare professionals as a clinically credible peer by asking insightful questions, listening actively, uncovering unmet needs, and connecting relevant evidence and resources to the customer's practice.
* Execute approved promotional programs, resources, and customer engagements with consistency, clinical relevance, sound judgment, and full adherence to company policies and regulatory requirements.


**Influence \& Impact**


* Help customers recognize gaps in disease awareness, patient identification, referral, treatment consideration, and ongoing support by reframing issues and connecting insights across the patient journey.
* Use high emotional intelligence, curiosity, credibility, and thoughtful questioning to build trust with skeptical, change\-resistant, or highly experienced healthcare professionals.
* Influence multiple stakeholders without authority, navigate resistance constructively, and balance persistence with judgment, empathy, and respect for customer boundaries


**Customer, Patient \& Caregiver Impact**


* Keep patients and caregivers at the center of territory and account decisions, with a clear understanding of the journey from disease recognition and diagnosis through treatment initiation and persistence.
* Support a customer experience grounded in trust, empathy, responsiveness, urgency, and reliable follow\-through with healthcare professionals and care teams.
* Collaborate compliantly with Market Access and Patient Services partners to help care teams understand available resources and navigate appropriate barriers in the patient journey.
* Identify recurring customer, access, and patient\-support barriers; elevate them objectively and promptly; and partner with the appropriate internal teams to improve execution and support.


**Cross\-Functional Collaboration \& Field Insights**


* Build productive partnerships with Medical Affairs, Market Access, Patient Services,

**About the Company**  

Founded in 2010, Eagle Creek Renewable Energy (ECRE) acquires, enhances, and operates hydroelectric power facilities across the United States. Today, Eagle Creek owns and operates 85 facilities across 18 states, with a nearly 700 MW portfolio that provides reliable, low\-carbon power to more than 260,000 homes.  

  

Eagle Creek is committed to creating long\-term value for its stakeholders and the communities it serves through a focus on safety, integrity, innovation, diversity, and stewardship. Through strategic investments, operational excellence, and continued growth, the company aims to expand its renewable energy platform and play a meaningful role in the transition to a cleaner, more sustainable energy future.  

  

**Summary of the Position**  

ECRE is seeking a versatile, self\-directed, and highly organized **ITC/PTC Program Manager** to drive the end\-to\-end lifecycle of our Investment Tax Credit (ITC) and Production Tax Credit (PTC) initiatives for our hydropower portfolio. In this role, you will serve as the single point of accountability, bridging cross\-functional inputs, and owning the qualification work and the evidence set that makes each facility’s credits defensible.  

  

While you will not be expected to be a tax code expert or a lead design engineer, you must possess enough technical fluency to understand hydropower project lifecycles, track vendor deliverables, interpret high\-level IRS compliance requirements, and manage cross\-functional timelines and budgets.  

  

**Main Responsibilities*** Credit Qualification Oversight: Serve as the single point of coordination for tracking and verifying all inputs, documentation, and milestones required to secure ITC/PTC qualifications.

* Cross\-Functional Coordination: Act as the central hub for a matrixed team, aligning inputs from supporting departments to support qualification requirements.
* IRS Compliance Alignment: Work alongside internal tax specialists to interpret high\-level IRS requirements and ensure that project workflows capture the necessary evidentiary trail for tax compliance.
* Vendor \& Deliverable Tracking: Monitor external vendor and contractor deliverables specifically tied to tax credit qualification requirements, ensuring reports, studies, and certifications are delivered on schedule.
* Schedule \& Milestone Monitoring: Maintain a master program tracker to monitor critical path qualification milestones, ensuring that project execution timelines managed by the PM team align with tax deadlines and safe\-harbor rules.
* Executive Reporting: Prepare clear, concise executive\-level dashboards and status reports summarizing program health, qualification risks, and key decision points for leadership and ownership.

**Education \& Experience Requirements**  

Required:* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Finance, Project Management, Business, or a related technical/analytical field.
* Experience: 3 to 8\+ years of professional experience in energy project development, asset management, project controls, or renewable energy finance/tax credit compliance. Hydropower experience is a strong plus.
* Cross\-Functional Fluency: Basic familiarity with energy tax credits (ITC/PTC) and an eagerness to learn IRS regulatory frameworks with the support of internal specialists.
* *Equivalent combinations of education, training, and experience may be considered where appropriate.*

**Competencies**  

The successful candidate should demonstrate the following competencies:* Communication:Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a proven ability to distill complex technical and financial tracking into executive\-ready reporting.
* Project Management: Demonstrated experience managing schedules, budgets, and matrixed or cross\-functional team workflows.
* Collaboration: Ability to work effectively with colleagues, teams, customers, or partners.
* Problem Solving: Ability to analyze issues, identify solutions, and exercise sound judgment.
* Organization: Ability to prioritize tasks, manage deadlines, and maintain accurate work.
* Technical/Functional Expertise: Comfortable reading technical project documentation, engineering reports, and understanding the core components of renewable energy assets (hydro\-specific knowledge is highly preferred).
* Adaptability: Ability to adjust to changing priorities, processes, or business needs.
* Accountability: Ability to take ownership of responsibilities and deliver expected results.
* Customer/Service Orientation: Ability to understand and respond effectively to customer or stakeholder needs.

Overview:

Working in a matrix environment, provides leadership and oversight of commercial lines underwriting quality in the regions, service center, and MUSIC. Works closely with the management teams in the field and the SBU’s to plan and complete Regional reviews . Compiles regional self\-reviews andcorporate underwriting reviews. Identifies trends and makes recommendations to corporate underwriting and field for improvement. Partners with the SBUs and LOB team, the UTS staff, the Operations team in Corporate, Insurance Learning Services, Actuarial and the Compliance department to implement technical training as necessary based on the review outcomes. Maintains the Sox requirements documents pertaining to the Quality Assurance program. All job duties and responsibilities must be carried out in compliance with applicable legal and regulatory requirements.

* Manage the quarterly underwriting reviews. Work with the field and SBUs to aggregate the review results, to identify trends and gaps in knowledge. Provide action plans and assist in addressing areas needing improvement by partnering with the SBUs, LOBs and Insurance Learning Services.

* Coordinate the formal underwriting regions, service center, and MUSIC reviews in accordance with the established schedule. Lead the review teams from the SBU and LOB as well as lead the wrap up discussions that include the Executive Management teams.

 **Education and Experience*** College degree
* Strong multi\-line underwriting technical skills
