new_jobs.title: Patient Service Representative - PD - Days - Patient Access @ MV
new_jobs.description:
**El Camino Health is committed to hiring, retaining and growing the best and brightest professionals who will carry our mission and vision forward. We are proud of our reputation in the community: One built on compassion, innovation, collaboration and delivering high\-quality care. Come join the team that makes this happen.**

**Applicants MUST apply for position(s) by submitting a separate application for each individual job posting number they are interested in being considered for.**

**FTE**


0**Scheduled Bi\-Weekly Hours**


0**Work Shift**


Day: 8 hours**Job Description**


The Patient Services Representative serves as the primary point of contact for patient electronic scheduling and registration. The role supports operations by coordinating schedules for patients and providers. The position works with patients, families, providers, clinical and non\-clinical staff to coordinate the patient's experience throughout the process of accessing healthcare. Interviews patients either by telephone or in person to effectively schedule and register. Establishes eligibility, verification of benefits, and identifying and collects co\-payments as appropriate. Obtains Authorizations if assigned. Communicates patient out of pocket responsibilities for services provided to the patient using a "Patient Friendly" approach. May perform other duties as assigned.


Registration: Collects, verifies and updates patient demographic and guarantor information. Verifies insurance benefits/eligibility, manages referrals runs the patient estimate using the Price Estimator Tool. Collects co\-pays and patient's estimated out of pocket expense as appropriate.  

  

Scheduling: Performs appointment scheduling, registration and customer service duties; answers incoming phone calls, makes appointments, monitors access issues with provider schedules that affect patient satisfaction, and communicates issues to Supervisor. Ensures schedules are appropriate use of clinical resources. Follows established parameters to ensure procedures, treatments, test, are scheduled with the required amount of time and effectively utilize resources.


Patient Satisfaction: This position is a key contributor to patient satisfaction initiatives within the department by participating in patient satisfaction related process improvement activities as well as providing a high quality contact experience for the patient with every interaction. Creates a positive patient experience improving patient satisfaction by facilitating appointment scheduling and preregistration at one point of contact. This process will also give the patient the appropriate instructions pertinent to their service, the financial liability as it relates to their scheduled service, and direction to the Hospital Service Department prior to their visit.

**Qualifications**


High School Diploma required, Associates degree preferred  

Two (2\) years medical office or medical insurance experience  

Demonstrates clear, courteous and pleasant communication skills with appropriate usage of grammar, pronunciation and tone  

Excellent customer service skills  

High level of self\-motivation and goal oriented with the ability to multitask  

Team oriented  

Positive, open\-minded, and focused on continuous improvement  

Ability to learn new processes, procedures and software programs quickly, while demonstrating attention to detail and accuracy  

Analytical and problem solving skills  

Proficiency with Microsoft Office and comfort with navigating multiple applications simultaneously  

Able to type 25 words per minute  

Scheduling or hospital registration experience preferred  

Experience in government and commercial insurance program, Third Party Payor, Medicare, MediCal, and other regulatory knowledge a plus.

**Salary Range:**


$40\.42 \- $51\.10 USD Hour**The Physical Requirements and Working Conditions of this job are available. El Camino Health will provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with a disability if that will allow them to perform the essential functions of a job unless doing so creates an undue hardship for the hospital, or causes a direct threat to these individuals or others in the workplace which cannot be eliminated by reasonable accommodation.**


Sedentary Work \- Duties performed mostly while sitting; walking and standing at times. Occasionally lift or carry up to 10 lbs. Uses hands and fingers. \- (Physical Requirements\-United States of America)**An Equal Opportunity Employer:**

El Camino Health prohibits discrimination in employment based on race, ancestry, national origin, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, disability, marital status, age, medical condition or any other status protected by law. new_jobs.title: Internship, FP&A & Business Operations (Summer 2027)
new_jobs.description:
**What to Expect**
Please consider before applying:


This position is expected to start May/June 2027 and continue through the entire Summer 2027 term (August/September.) We ask for a minimum of 12 weeks, full\-time, for most internships. Please consider before applying.


International Students: If your work authorization is through CPT, please consult your school on your ability to work 40 hours per week before applying. Again, please do not apply until you know you can work 40 hours per week. This is required for external applicants. Many students will be limited to part\-time during the academic year.


This internship is located in multiple locations depending on team placement. The locations are as follows:


Palo Alto, CA


Austin, TX


Fremont, CA


Sparks, NV


Tesla Finance combines traditional financial planning and analysis with broader business decision\- making and strategy. Finance is embedded in daily operations, supporting both near\-term execution and long\-term planning. Team members are expected to analyze data, provide recommendations, and lead cross\-functional decision\-making and implementation of the recommendations with the relevant executives/teams throughout the company. Through the intern program, we are looking to find the next wave of talent to drive these efforts.


Financial Planning \& Analysis (FP\&A) works with our Finance and Accounting leadership team and other subgroups to:

* Lead Tesla’s P\&L, balance sheet and cash flow forecast process, including reviewing with Tesla’s Leadership and Board of Directors and working with finance and non\-finance stakeholders to analyze the impact of proposed business decisions
* Develop and track cross\-company efforts to improve gross margin and cash flow
* Lead long term planning for Tesla, including new products/capabilities, and capital need


Engineering Finance works with the Supply Chain and Engineering teams to:

* Manage R\&D investments/planning for Engineering (e.g. return on investment analyses for new technology development, resource planning, etc.) and develop associated forecasts
* Track, report, and proactively manage profit improvement (e.g. design proposals, supply chain initiatives) on existing vehicles Support product development by establishing cost targets and guiding engineering, design and supply chain decisions towards attainment of these targets (i.e. cost vs. performance tradeoffs)


Manufacturing Finance (Fremont, CA, Sparks, NV and Austin, TX) works with the Manufacturing, Quality, and Supply Chain teams to:

* Manage all manufacturing investments globally and develop associated forecasts
* Evaluate major CapEx decisions and expansion plans as well as business cases on automation, manufacturing scope, insource vs. outsource choices, and location
* Lead manufacturing cost improvement for all products, including feedback on estimated manufacturing costs for future programs, identification of focus areas for cost, and execution of identified initiatives


Energy Products Finance works with the Energy Storage and Solar teams to:

* Consolidate inputs on business activities and develop financial projections; maintain projections and track actual financial performance against plan
* Drive cost optimization in product development for existing and future products with a focus on establishment and attainment of cost targets Lead pricing efforts for Energy Products, including installation and services, and business planning for global retail, service and sales enablement


Sales, Marketing and Service (SMS) Finance works with the Sales, Service and Marketing teams to:

* Manage investments into SMS activities, develop associated forecasts, and lead profitability analysis/improvement initiatives as the global and regional level
* Lead pricing efforts, including options and services, and business planning for global retail, service and sales enablement
* Develop and evaluate ROI for new markets, new business models, used vehicles, and service
  

**What You'll Do*** Interns will be assigned to one of the above subgroups based on prior experience, interests, and educational background
  

**What You'll Bring*** Evidence of exceptional ability, especially within an ambiguous environment
* Currently pursuing a Degree in Finance, Accounting, Engineering, or equivalent
* A robust analytical skill\-set Excellent modeling skills (e.g. Microsoft Office Excel; experience with Microsoft PowerQuery/Power BI and/or SQL a plus)
* Ability to work independently, detail\-oriented, and execution focused
* Strong verbal, written and presentation skills
* Highly collaborative and team\-oriented
#### **Benefits**

  

As a full\-time Tesla Intern, you will be eligible for:


* Medical plans \> plan options with $0 payroll deduction
* Family\-building, fertility, adoption and surrogacy benefits
* Dental (including orthodontic coverage) and vision plans. Both have an option with a $0 payroll contribution
* Company Paid (Health Savings Account) HSA Contribution when enrolled in the High Deductible Medical Plan with HSA
* Healthcare and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
* 401(k), Employee Stock Purchase Plans, and other financial benefits
* Company Paid Basic Life, AD\&D, and short\-term disability insurance (90 day waiting period)
* Employee Assistance Program
* Sick and Vacation time (Flex time for salary positions), and Paid Holidays
* Back\-up childcare and parenting support resources
* Voluntary benefits to include: critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, theft \& legal services, and pet insurance
* Commuter benefits
* Employee discounts and perks program
  
  

#### **Expected Compensation**


$36\.06 \- $50\.48 \+ benefits
Pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements dependent on the position offered. Detai

new_jobs.title: Assistant Security Account Manager
new_jobs.description:
Assistant Security Account Manager

**Overview**
------------

  

Company Overview:
Allied Universal®, North America’s leading security and facility services company, offers rewarding careers that provide you a sense of purpose. While working in a dynamic, welcoming, and collaborative workplace, you will be part of a team that contributes to a culture that positively impacts the communities and customers we serve.**Job Description**
-------------------

  

Allied Universal is looking to hire an Assistant Account Manager. The Assistant Account Manager job is responsible for assisting the Account Manager with all supervisory, training and operations functions at the assigned post in accordance with post orders and client instructions, and following all internal procedures. To support and ensure success in this role, we provide a comprehensive, week\-long management onboarding course designed to provide best practices, tools and guidance.
**RESPONSIBILITIES:*** Under the direction of the Account Manager, this position assists with the coordination of all aspects (technical and managerial) of executing the security contract at the assigned location. Assigns work tasks to Security Professionals and directs their work throughout the day
* This position is the first direct supervisory contact for shift supervisors (if applicable to site) or for Security Professionals, regarding performance, operations, and department needs. Responsible for supervising, motivating, coaching and training Also responsible for evaluating the work performance of Security Professionals and making recommendations regarding assignments
* Responsible for making sure that Post Order manual and all other post and training information is being properly maintained and updated, and that the Post is being properly maintained, cleaned and organized
* Assist the Account Manager in conducting interviews and evaluating new employees. Responsible for conducting on\-the\-job training, in coordination with Shift Supervisors, of new employees assigned to post, or when changes to post orders are made. * Oversees all reports, logs and pass downs generated by and for the Security Department. Distributes communications and other information to Security Professionals at post as directed
* Manages and supervises all sub\-units within the Security Department, such as fire control room, command center, and loading docks as applicable to job site. May generate work orders and attached paperwork for extra security coverage requests
* Responds to minor incidents (internal to Security Professionals and/or external to client location) that occur, ensuring appropriate action is taken, all reports are properly completed, and appropriate parties are notified in a timely manner

new_jobs.title: ITC/PTC Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
**About the Company**  

Founded in 2010, Eagle Creek Renewable Energy (ECRE) acquires, enhances, and operates hydroelectric power facilities across the United States. Today, Eagle Creek owns and operates 85 facilities across 18 states, with a nearly 700 MW portfolio that provides reliable, low\-carbon power to more than 260,000 homes.  

  

Eagle Creek is committed to creating long\-term value for its stakeholders and the communities it serves through a focus on safety, integrity, innovation, diversity, and stewardship. Through strategic investments, operational excellence, and continued growth, the company aims to expand its renewable energy platform and play a meaningful role in the transition to a cleaner, more sustainable energy future.  

  

**Summary of the Position**  

ECRE is seeking a versatile, self\-directed, and highly organized **ITC/PTC Program Manager** to drive the end\-to\-end lifecycle of our Investment Tax Credit (ITC) and Production Tax Credit (PTC) initiatives for our hydropower portfolio. In this role, you will serve as the single point of accountability, bridging cross\-functional inputs, and owning the qualification work and the evidence set that makes each facility’s credits defensible.  

  

While you will not be expected to be a tax code expert or a lead design engineer, you must possess enough technical fluency to understand hydropower project lifecycles, track vendor deliverables, interpret high\-level IRS compliance requirements, and manage cross\-functional timelines and budgets.  

  

**Main Responsibilities*** Credit Qualification Oversight: Serve as the single point of coordination for tracking and verifying all inputs, documentation, and milestones required to secure ITC/PTC qualifications.
* Audit \& Diligence Readiness: Maintain a clean, contemporaneous qualification file for each facility that withstands tax\-preparer, credit\-buyer, insurer, and IRS review.
* Cross\-Functional Coordination: Act as the central hub for a matrixed team, aligning inputs from supporting departments to support qualification requirements.
* IRS Compliance Alignment: Work alongside internal tax specialists to interpret high\-level IRS requirements and ensure that project workflows capture the necessary evidentiary trail for tax compliance.
* Vendor \& Deliverable Tracking: Monitor external vendor and contractor deliverables specifically tied to tax credit qualification requirements, ensuring reports, studies, and certifications are delivered on schedule.
* Schedule \& Milestone Monitoring: Maintain a master program tracker to monitor critical path qualification milestones, ensuring that project execution timelines managed by the PM team align with tax deadlines and safe\-harbor rules.
* Executive Reporting: Prepare clear, concise executive\-level dashboards and status reports summarizing program health, qualification risks, and key decision points for leadership and ownership.

**Education \& Experience Requirements**  

Required:* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Finance, Project Management, Business, or a related technical/analytical field.
* Experience: 3 to 8\+ years of professional experience in energy project development, asset management, project controls, or renewable energy finance/tax credit compliance. Hydropower experience is a strong plus.
* Cross\-Functional Fluency: Basic familiarity with energy tax credits (ITC/PTC) and an eagerness to learn IRS regulatory frameworks with the support of internal specialists.
* *Equivalent combinations of education, training, and experience may be considered where appropriate.*

**Competencies**  

The successful candidate should demonstrate the following competencies:* Communication:Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a proven ability to distill complex technical and financial tracking into executive\-ready reporting.
* Project Management: Demonstrated experience managing schedules, budgets, and matrixed or cross\-functional team workflows.
* Collaboration: Ability to work effectively with colleagues, teams, customers, or partners.
* Problem Solving: Ability to analyze issues, identify solutions, and exercise sound judgment.
* Organization: Ability to prioritize tasks, manage deadlines, and maintain accurate work.
* Technical/Functional Expertise: Comfortable reading technical project documentation, engineering reports, and understanding the core components of renewable energy assets (hydro\-specific knowledge is highly preferred).
* Adaptability: Ability to adjust to changing priorities, processes, or business needs.
* Accountability: Ability to take ownership of responsibilities and deliver expected results.
* Customer/Service Orientation: Ability to understand and respond effectively to customer or stakeholder needs.

**Supervisory Responsibilities**  

This position does not have direct supervisory responsibilities.  

  

**Travel Requirements**  

This position requires occasional travel (\~10%) as part of the job responsibilities if the hire is not located locally in Washington, DC Metro area.  

  

**Work Schedule Requirements**  

The typical work schedule for this position is Monday through Friday. This position is remote/hybrid and may require:* Overtime as needed.
* Flexibility to adjust working hours based on business needs.
* The schedule and work hours may be adjusted based on organizational needs and the requirements of the position.

**Supervisory Responsibilities**  

This position does not have direct supervisory responsibilities.  

  

**Benefits**  

Eagle Creek offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the health, well\-being, and professional development of our employees. Benefits may include:* Medical, Dental, Vision, HSA, FSA, Commuter benefits, Voluntary Life, 401(k) match
* Competitive holiday \& PTO schedule, including time off for community volunteering.

*Benefits eligibility may vary based on employment status, position, length of serv

new_jobs.title: Project Manager, ServiceNow ITSM Program
new_jobs.description:
About DMI:

DMI is a leading provider of digital services and technology solutions, headquartered in Tysons Corner, VA. With a focus on end\-to\-end managed IT services, including managed mobility, cloud, cybersecurity, network operations, and application development, DMI supports public sector agencies and commercial enterprises around the globe. Recognized as a Top Workplace, DMI is committed to delivering secure, efﬁcient, and cost\-effective solutions that drive measurable results. Learn more at www.dminc.com
About the Opportunity:

DMI, LLC is seeking an opportunity for a **Project Manager** to lead delivery of a ServiceNow service management maturity, support, and development program for the U.S. Senate Sergeant at Arms (SAA). The program runs in two phases: an assessment and planning phase producing a current\-state baseline, future\-state service delivery model, and prioritized implementation roadmap; followed by iterative implementation against the customer\-approved roadmap.  

The Project Manager is the single accountable point for schedule, budget, risk, and a deliverable set spanning project management, governance, implementation, testing, training, organizational change management, and closeout. The role runs an Agile delivery cadence inside a formal Government acceptance process, so the right candidate is fluent in both sprint mechanics and deliverable discipline, and does not treat either as overhead. **Duties and Responsibilities:*** **Project Planning and Schedule**
* + Develop the Project Plan covering approach, schedule, milestones, activities, dependencies, resources, deliverables, and proposed delivery methodology, due within 20 business days of award.
	+ Develop, monitor, and maintain the project schedule and product backlog; track and report progress against both.
	+ Maintain the deliverable cadence map aligning every required deliverable to a specific sprint, release, or phase timeline, kept current throughout the period of performance.
* **Deliverable and Acceptance Management**
* + Track and manage all deliverables through draft, Government review and comment, and formal written COR acceptance.
	+ Produce the Weekly Status Report covering accomplishments, planned activities, schedule status, deliverable status, risks and issues, dependencies, decisions needed, and upcoming milestones.
	+ Manage rework and resubmission when a deliverable is rejected, without losing the underlying delivery cadence.
* **Agile Delivery**
* + Serve as Scrum Master for the delivery team: facilitate ceremonies, remove impediments, and protect sprint scope.
	+ Implement Agile project management methodologies in practice, adapting where Government acceptance gates are sequential rather than iterative.
	+ Support release and sprint planning, including scope, user stories, acceptance criteria, dependencies, testing, and change management considerations.
* **Risk, Issue, and Financial Management**
* + Identify, assess, and mitigate risks and issues; own the Risk, Issue, Action, and Decision Log throughout the period of performance.
	+ Track and manage budget, burn, and resource utilization against funded scope.
	+ Escalate funding, dependency, and technical feasibility constraints that affect roadmap sequencing.
* **Stakeholder Communication**
* + Develop, monitor, and maintain the project schedule and product backlog; track and report progress against both. Maintain the deliverable cadence map aligning every required deliverable to a specific sprint, release, or phase timeline, kept current throughout the period of performance.
	+ Serve as the primary management interface to the COR and customer leadership.
	+ Ensure the use of industry best practices, techniques, and standards across the delivery team.
	+ Brief status, risk, and recommendations in plain language to technical and non\-technical audiences.


Qualifications:
**Education, Certification, and Years of Experience:*** Bachelor of Science degree.
* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.
* Four to six years of relevant project management experience.

**Required Skills and Qualifications:*** Demonstrated experience managing enterprise IT service management or platform implementation projects of comparable scope and complexity.
* Demonstrated ability to serve as Scrum Master and implement Agile project management methodologies in practice.
* Working familiarity with Waterfall methodologies and the ability to operate in a hybrid delivery environment.
* Demonstrated experience managing a formal Government deliverable set through draft, review, and written acceptance.
* Experience managing project budget and reporting financial status to a Government customer.
* Experience owning a risk and issue register and driving mitigation to closure.
* Exceptional interpersonal skills and a proven ability to build and maintain effective working relationships with all project stakeholders.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to successfully complete the background investigation required for U.S. Senate facility and system access, and to meet ongoing personnel security reporting requirements. \[Confirm investigation level and adjudication timeline.

**Additional Requirements:*** Prior Legislative Branch, U.S. Senate, or Capitol Hill program experience.
* Experience managing a program carrying both recurring deliverables and phase\-gated acceptance milestones.
* Prior experience on a ServiceNow implementation, migration, or platform maturity engagement.
* Experience managing a delivery team that includes organizational change management and training functions.
* This position is designated Key Personnel under the contract. Substitution requires customer notification and approval.
* Deliverables are subject to formal Government review and written Contracting Officer's Representative (COR) acceptance.

**Citizenship Status Required:** Must be a U.S. Citizen **Physical Requirements:** No Physical requirement needed

Diversified is a global leader in audiovisual and media technology. We design and build innovative spaces and experiences for clients across industries such as corporate, entertainment, sports, retail, and government. Our team partners with organizations around the world to create environments that connect people through technology.
  
  

**What to Expect:**  

At Diversified, you’ll work on exciting and complex projects with opportunities to grow your career. We offer a collaborative and flexible work environment, competitive pay and benefits, and a culture that values diversity, inclusion, and innovation. If you’re ready to grow, create, and make an impact, Diversified is the place to do it.

As a Senior Project Manager in Electronic Security Systems (ESS), you oversee all aspects of project execution—including scope, schedule, budget, quality, and client satisfaction—across the entire project lifecycle, from initiation to closure. The Sr PM will act as the person responsible on their assigned projects and have direct control over all project management activities. This position provides oversight and direction to a wide range of internal and external stakeholders.

Demonstrated proficiency in developing schedules, establishing project baselines, and identifying, qualifying, and quantifying deviations, with clear communication of impacts to the client.

Requires proven experience in coordinating all critical activities involved in the successful commissioning of security systems, including planning, execution, testing, and documentation. Works closely with the site supervisor, general contractor, and end user to develop and manage a comprehensive punch list of outstanding tasks following substantial completion. Ensures timely resolution of remaining items to support project closeout and client satisfaction.
  
  

Facilitates project turnover and training sessions with clients, and service team.

new_jobs.description:
**The Role:**

The Sales Enablement Manager will architect, deliver, and continuously refine the programs, content, and skills that drive predictable revenue execution across Apryse's global field organization. This is a senior individual contributor role for an enablement professional who combines field credibility, instructional design rigor, and a data\-first operating model. You will partner directly with sales leadership, Revenue Operations, Product Marketing, and front\-line sellers to translate revenue priorities into measurable enablement outcomes that move pipeline, ramp time, and win rate.



This role is built for someone who has carried a quota, lived the realities of the sales floor, and now wants to scale those instincts through programs, technology, and data.

  


**Responsibilities:**

Onboarding \& Ramp



* Design and operate a tiered onboarding program spanning SDRs, BDRs, AEs, AMs, and Customer Success, with defined ramp milestones and certification gates.
* Benchmark ramp\-time\-to\-first\-deal and ramp\-time\-to\-quota against historical cohorts and continuously reduce both.
Continuous Enablement \& Methodology



* Build a recurring cadence of skill, product, and competitive training prioritized against gaps surfaced in pipeline, win/loss, and conversation intelligence data.
* Own deployment, reinforcement, and adoption of Apryse's sales methodology across the field.
Content, Playbooks \& Field Tools



* Develop and govern playbooks, battlecards, discovery guides, demo scripts, and competitive content in partnership with Product Marketing.
* Maintain a single source of truth for enablement assets and drive measurable rep adoption.
Launch Readiness



* Own enablement workstreams for product, pricing, packaging, and tooling launches, ensuring the field can position, demo, and close with confidence on day one.
* Incorporate acquired technologies and acquired\-company sellers into the global enablement plan.
Data\-Driven Program Design



* Instrument every program with leading and lagging indicators tied to revenue outcomes.
* Pull from Salesforce, Gong (or equivalent conversation intelligence), Salesloft/Outreach, and enablement platforms to diagnose performance gaps and prioritize investment.
* Publish enablement performance dashboards and quarterly impact reviews to the CRO, VP Sales \& Revenue Enablement, and executive stakeholders.
Partnerships \& Vendor Management



* Source and manage external training partners, instructional designers, and enablement tooling vendors as needed.
  


**Requirements:**

Sales Background \& Field Credibility



* Quota\-carrying experience strongly preferred. 5\+ years of B2B sales or revenue experience, with at least 2 years in a quota\-carrying or front\-line sales management role highly valued. Direct experience selling SaaS, developer tools, or technical/API\-led products is a significant advantage.
* Field empathy. Demonstrated understanding of the daily realities of AEs, SDRs, and front\-line managers, with the ability to translate that lived experience into credible enablement design.
Enablement \& Program Design



* 3\+ years designing, delivering, and measuring sales enablement programs \- onboarding, methodology rollout, continuous learning, and launch readiness.
* Fluency in modern B2B sales methodologies (MEDDPICC, Challenger, Command of the Message, SPIN, or similar).
* Track record building or scaling enablement functions inside high\-growth, PE\-backed, or acquisition\-active environments.
* Strong instructional design instincts; able to design adult\-learning experiences that drive behavior change, not just content consumption.
Data \& Analytics



* Data\-driven by default. Strong analytical orientation; comfortable instrumenting programs, defining KPIs, and translating dashboards into program decisions.
* Hands\-on tooling fluency. Salesforce, conversation intelligence (Gong/Chorus), sales engagement (Salesloft/Outreach), and enablement platforms (Highspot/Seismic/Mindtickle).
* Diagnostic mindset. Able to translate sales data into root\-cause diagnoses and targeted interventions, not generic training.
* AI\-fluent. Comfortable using AI\-assisted coaching, content, and analytics tools to scale enablement output and personalization.
Execution \& Influence



* Strong project management discipline with a track record of delivering on aggressive timelines.
* Effective communicator at every level \- capable of briefing executives one hour and coaching front\-line reps the next.
* Bias toward action, ownership, and measurable outcomes over activity for its own sake.
**Compensation Philosophy**



The compensation for this position is commensurate upon experience, and the range listed reflects total compensation or on target earnings. The top end of the range is reserved for candidates with extensive experience and a profile that strongly aligns with the senior expectations of this role.


**Benefits:**


* Competitive salary commensurate with experience and qualifications.
* A comprehensive extended benefits package including health, dental and vision for you and your family, with company paid offerings.
* An uncapped commissions structure.
* Generous paid time off (PTO) is offered to support the ability to rest and recharge.
* A great team environment and resources, supporting you to do the best work of your life and providing unlimited career growth potential.
* Highly autonomous and entrepreneurial environment.
* Annual recurring WFH allowance for you to purchase items you need for your home office.
* Ongoing support for learning development so you can master your craft.
* Work with the hardware you're most comfortable with (Windows or Mac).
* Diverse and inclusive workplace where we all learn from each other.

**Cloudnet Systems LLC \| Remote (CONUS) supporting Scott AFB, IL \| Full time \| Start November 6, 2026 (contingent on contract award)**

**About the role**

Cloudnet Systems LLC is preparing a quotation for a five\-year Department of Defense task order supporting the Defense Information Systems Agency (DISA) Defense Information Technology Contracting Organization (DITCO) Transition Program Management Office at Scott Air Force Base, Illinois. The team helps DoD agencies move their telecommunications services from expiring GSA contracts (NETWORX, WITS 3, CVS and regional contracts) to the GSA Enterprise Infrastructure Solutions (EIS) contract and DITCO voice contracts without service disruption. The work covers about 35,000 services, 70,000 service orders and 40 customer data networks over the life of the program.

This is a key personnel position. Your resume will be submitted with our quotation, and you must be available to start full time on November 6, 2026\. The position is contingent on contract award, which we expect to be decided in October 2026\.

**What you will do**

You own the planning documents and schedules that drive DoD agency transitions to new telecommunications contracts, and you keep the program's risks and lessons learned current.

\- Maintain the Transition Strategy and Management Plan, the Transition Project Management Plan and the Transition Master Schedule with the Government PMO.

\- Review individual agency transition plans and regional service plans for feasibility and alignment, and document findings in quarterly Transition Planning Analysis Reports.

\- Maintain the stakeholder register and coordinate with plan authors, customer agencies and GSA EIS contractors on areas of concern.

\- Identify risks, develop mitigation approaches, and maintain the program risk register.

\- Establish and run the lessons learned process and produce the Lessons Learned Report at transition completion.

\- Support integration of all task areas, status reporting and program reviews with the Program Manager.

**Required qualifications**

\- Bachelor's degree from an accredited institution (required, no substitution).

\- U.S. citizenship (required by the contract).

\- Able to obtain a Tier 1 (NACI) background investigation and a DoD Common Access Card. A current Tier 1 or higher investigation is a plus but not required; the Government sponsors the investigation.

\- Available to begin full\-time work on November 6, 2026\.

\- At least 5 years of project management experience on federal IT or telecommunications programs.

\- Demonstrated experience producing integrated master schedules, risk registers and formal planning documents for a Government customer.

**Preferred qualifications**

\- Experience with telecommunications contract transitions or large multi\-agency migrations.

\- PMP certification.

\- Experience with GSA transition plan formats or the EIS transition program.

**Location and schedule**

\- Remote within the continental United States. Occasional travel to Scott Air Force Base, Illinois, to receive or exchange Government equipment.

\- Core hours 8:00 AM to 4:30 PM Central, Monday through Friday. Occasional after\-hours support for service cutovers.

\- Full time, W\-2 employee of Cloudnet Systems LLC.

**Compensation**

$52 to $60 per hour depending on experience.

**How to apply**

Apply with a current resume. Because this position will be submitted as key personnel, we will ask selected candidates to confirm availability for the November 6, 2026 start date and to sign a short letter of intent. Cloudnet Systems LLC is an equal opportunity employer.

Pay: $52\.00 \- $60\.00 per hour

Application Question(s):

* Do you hold a Bachelor's degree from an accredited institution?
* Are you a U.S. citizen?
* Are you available to begin full\-time work on November 6, 2026?
* How many years of experience do you have with telecommunications service ordering, circuit inventory, or network transitions?
* Have you worked on GSA EIS, NETWORX, WITS 3 or DISA telecommunications programs?

Work Location: Remote

SolvOne is seeking an experienced Fuels Project Manager to manage underground storage tank (UST) replacements and related fuel\-system construction projects across multiple locations. This position will oversee projects from initial planning and site coordination through construction, startup, and closeout. The Fuels Project Manager will serve as a central point of coordination between customers, contractors, equipment vendors, regulatory agencies, A\&E firms, and other project stakeholders to help ensure projects are completed safely, compliantly, on schedule, and in accordance with the approved scope of work.

***Responsibilities***

* Manage underground storage tank replacement and related petroleum construction projects from planning through completion and closeout.
* Review project scope, site information, drawings, schedules, contractor proposals, and other project documentation to identify requirements and potential project risks.
* Coordinate project activities with customer representatives, general contractors, petroleum contractors, environmental consultants, equipment vendors, and other stakeholders.
* Coordinate permitting, inspections, testing, and regulatory requirements associated with UST and fuel\-system construction projects.
* Track project schedules, milestones, dependencies, and critical activities to help ensure projects remain on schedule.
* Coordinate site shutdowns, tank removal and installation activities, piping and fueling\-system work, testing, inspections, startup, and return\-to\-service activities as applicable.
* Monitor contractor progress and follow up on open issues, delays, deficiencies, and outstanding deliverables.
* Review field conditions and project changes and coordinate resolution of scope, schedule, or construction issues.
* Compare completed work against approved plans, scopes of work, and customer requirements.
* Develop and maintain punch lists and track outstanding items through completion.
* Maintain accurate project records, schedules, status reports, issue logs, photographs, permits, inspection documentation, and closeout records.
* Provide regular project updates to customers and internal stakeholders, including schedule status, open issues, risks, and required decisions.
* Escalate issues that may affect safety, regulatory compliance, cost, schedule, or successful project completion.
* Manage multiple projects in different phases and geographic locations simultaneously.
* Conduct or participate in site visits, construction meetings, project walks, punch walks, and final inspections as required.
* Coordinate travel efficiently to support assigned projects.
* Follow all customer safety, confidentiality, documentation, and site\-access requirements.

***Qualifications***

* Project management experience within the petroleum, fueling, UST, or retail fuel construction industry required.
* Direct experience managing underground storage tank replacement, tank modification, fuel\-system construction, or major petroleum equipment projects strongly preferred.
* Working knowledge of UST systems and petroleum construction, including tanks, piping, dispensers, sumps, spill containment, leak detection, and associated fueling equipment.
* Familiarity with permitting, inspections, environmental requirements, and regulatory processes associated with UST construction and replacement projects.
* Experience coordinating petroleum contractors, general contractors, environmental consultants, equipment vendors, inspectors, and customer stakeholders.
* Ability to read and interpret construction drawings, site plans, scopes of work, specifications, schedules, and project documentation.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple simultaneous projects, locations, contractors, and deadlines.
* Strong project planning, organization, documentation, and follow\-through skills.
* Ability to identify project risks, anticipate potential delays, and drive issues toward resolution.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively with field personnel, contractors, customers, and leadership.
* Ability to work independently, make sound decisions, and manage priorities without continuous supervision.
* Proficiency with standard business applications and the ability to learn customer\-specific project management and reporting systems.
* Ability to efficiently manage geographically dispersed projects.

***What else?***

new_jobs.title: Senior Clinical Project Manager - CNS
new_jobs.description:
The Senior Clinical Project Manager (PM) supports/is responsible for the overall project coordination and management of clinical studies, including all project deliverables, from start up through close out activities. This is accomplished by ensuring all projects are completed on\-time and on\-budget within the scope of the client agreements. The PM is responsible for the cross\-functional team’s compliance with project Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Good Clinical Practice (GCP)/International Conference on Harmonization (ICH) guidelines, and other applicable regulations. The PM is also responsible for managing study staff and across department initiatives while maintaining client satisfaction.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Lead the initiation, planning, execution, and closeout of clinical studies, ensuring adherence to timelines, budgets, and quality standards.
* Serve as a client\-facing representative; coordinate and lead project meetings, develop agendas, and issue meeting minutes.
* Develop and maintain core study documentation including Project Management Plans, Communication Plans, Risk Logs, timelines, and milestone trackers.
* Manage study budgets, proposals, contracts, and out‑of‑scope documentation; support financial tracking and invoicing processes.
* Support start‑up activities including collection of CDAs, feasibility information, budgets, and CTAs; maintain regulatory and study files.
* Coordinate with functional teams to allocate resources and balance workload across the project.
* Identify project risks and delays; implement contingency and risk‑control measures.
* Oversee TMF management to ensure organization, accuracy, and inspection readiness.
* Manage vendors and ensure their deliverables align with study requirements and quality expectations.
* Support preparation of clinical reports and key study documentation.
* Ensure compliance with SOPs, regulatory guidelines, and study\-specific training requirements.
* Perform additional project\-related duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or RN in a related field or equivalent combination of education, training and experience
* Minimum of 3 years relevant clinical research industry experience
* Project Manager experience commensurate with years in the industry, and sufficient to successfully perform key responsibilities
* Supervisory experience
* Advanced knowledge of GCPs, ICH guidelines, FDA and other applicable regulations.
* Intermediate knowledge of project management techniques
* Proficient in Microsoft Office, Adobe and Project Management software
* Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to work with all levels of management and employees; ability to gain credibility, provide effective customer service, and foster positive working relationships with internal and external stakeholders
* Ability to function independently in a fast\-paced team environment
* Effective verbal and writing skills; English proficiency
* Ability to travel 10\-20%

===========================


This position is in GE Healthcare's MIM Software business which makes vendor\-neutral imaging software to standardize your workflow and simplify increasingly complex clinical scenarios. Leading global healthcare organizations use MIM® to give patients more precise, personalized care.  

  

https://www.mimsoftware.com/  

  

As a Lead Implementation Project Manager, you will drive enterprise\-level deployments of the MIM clinical software platform across complex healthcare environments. You will lead multi\-site implementations that span digital tools, imaging systems, and clinical workflows—owning planning, configuration, integration, go\-live, and clinical adoption.**Job Description**

* Lead enterprise\-scale, multi\-site implementations and executive reporting.
* Coordinate across Digital, Imaging/Modality, Clinical Applications, Services, and Customer IT.
* Install, configure, validate, and support MIM deployments and integrations.
* Manage multiple projects, scope, risks, timelines, and customer expectations.
* Partner with clinicians and IT to align workflows to clinical use cases.
* Mentor project managers and drive continuous improvement.

**Required Qualifications**

* 5–7\+ years in software/digital implementation project management.
* Bachelor’s degree in IT, Engineering, Business, or related field.
* Experience with enterprise software deployment and healthcare interoperability.
* Knowledge of networks, servers, and security fundamentals.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, and risk mitigation skills.

* Master’s degree preferred.
* Experience with system architecture, integration, and security frameworks.

new_jobs.title: Financial IT Project Manager (5670)
new_jobs.description:
SMX is seeking a dynamic and experienced **Project Manager** to lead the implementation of our CFO Control Tower Budget and Spend (BAS) solution for a key federal government client. This role requires a leader who can expertly navigate the complexities of federal financial management projects, ensuring the successful deployment of a cutting\-edge planning and reporting tool built on the SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) platform.



This is a unique and exciting role that allows the right candidate to use their deep understanding of federal budgeting and planning processes to help build our next generation planning application. We are looking for an energetic and creative federal financial business analyst to take our solution to the next level and drive value for our federal customers. You will be working alongside a talented team of designers, developers and budget SMEs to help build, enhance, and roll out our best\-in\-class solution. This is a full\-time position that is 100% remote and will require minimal travel \<20% and requires a Public Trust clearance.


**Essential Duties \& Responsibilities:**



The ideal candidate will be responsible for the entire project lifecycle, from planning and execution to stakeholder management and final delivery. You will serve as the primary point of contact for the client, ensuring that our "Shared Vision. Outcome Assured." motto is realized through meticulous planning, clear communication, and a relentless focus on achieving mission objectives.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* Project Leadership: Direct and manage the full lifecycle of the CFO Control Tower BAS implementation project, including scope, schedule, budget, and quality, from initiation to closure.
* Stakeholder Management: Serve as the primary liaison between federal client stakeholders, SMX technical teams, and third\-party vendors to ensure clear communication and alignment of project goals.
* Planning \& Execution: Develop and maintain a comprehensive project plan, outlining tasks, timelines, resource allocation, and dependencies. Proactively manage risks and develop mitigation strategies.
* Technical Oversight: While not a hands\-on technical role, maintain a strong understanding of the SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) platform and the functional aspects of the BAS solution to guide the project effectively.
* Team Coordination: Lead a cross\-functional team of business analysts, data engineers, and solution architects, fostering a collaborative environment to break down stovepipes and deliver targeted capabilities.
* Reporting \& Governance: Provide regular, transparent status reports on project progress, risks, and financial health to both client leadership and SMX executive management.
* Quality Assurance: Ensure the final solution meets all client requirements, is delivered on time, within budget, and adheres to the highest standards of quality and federal security protocols.

**Required Skills \& Experience:**


* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, Finance, or a related field.
* Minimum of 10 years' experience as a Project Manager leading complex IT or financial system implementations.
* Proven experience managing SAP ERP implementation and upgrade projects, demonstrating strong project management skills and a deep understanding of SAP systems.
* Demonstrated experience managing projects for U.S. Federal Government agencies.
* Strong understanding of the project management lifecycle and methodologies (e.g., PMP, Agile, Hybrid).
* Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to manage and influence diverse stakeholder groups.
* Must be a US Citizen and have the ability to obtain a Public Trust clearance.


**Desired Skills \& Experience**


* Experience in managing an SAP ERP or SAP EPM project is highly desirable.
* PMP Certification is highly desired.
* Direct experience with SAP solutions, particularly SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) for planning and reporting.
* Familiarity with federal budgeting, financial planning, and reporting processes (e.g., PPBE).
* Previous experience implementing COTS (Commercial Off\-The\-Shelf) or pre\-built software solutions.
* Experience managing projects with a significant data integration or business intelligence component.



\# LI\-SA1



\#CJPOST

  




At SMX®, we are a team of technical and domain experts dedicated to enabling your mission. From priority national security initiatives for the DoD to highly assured and compliant solutions for healthcare, we understand that digital transformation is key to your future success.



We share your vision for the future and strive to accelerate your impact on the world. We bring both cutting edge technology and an expansive view of what's possible to every engagement. Our delivery model and unique approaches harness our deep technical and domain knowledge, providing forward\-looking insights and practical solutions to power secure mission acceleration.



SMX is an Equal Opportunity employer including disabilities and veterans.



Selected applicant may be subject to a background investigation and/or education verification.



SMX does not sponsor a new applicant for employment authorization or immigration related support for this position (i.e. H1B, F\-1 OPT, F\-1 STEM OPT, F\-1 CPT, J\-1, TN, E\-2, E\-3, L\-1 and O\-1, or any EADs or other forms of work authorization that require immigration support from an employer).

Third and Grove is a fully remote full\-service digital agency. Our vision is to use technology and design to make the web worth browsing. We want to leave the web better than we found it. **About Darkhorse Tech**


Darkhorse Tech provides comprehensive Dental\-Specific IT services to our clients including ongoing support (Managed Services), startup projects \& expansions (planning, design, buildouts) as well as software \& hardware sales and maintenance.


As a leader in the industry, we have created and continue to foster relationships with all leading\-edge technology companies servicing the Dental community. Our company was created by founder and CEO, Reuben Kamp who left his job at a nationwide Dental IT company to build a relationship\-focused version of a Managed Service Provider (MSP) which creates true partnerships with it's clients.


Constantly building on our 13 years of experience we are now servicing roughly 1400 clients nationwide and continue to see massive growth while focusing on maintaining unparalleled support for our Dental Practice partners. With technicians on the ground throughout the country we offer in\-person as well as remote support.


**About You**


Service first. Providing exemplary service means recognizing it. Have you put off a call to your cell phone company because the idea of waiting on hold, requesting a manager only to fight for a solution seems exhausting? Have you ever been pleasantly surprised by a service organization where your call is addressed efficiently, with care and acknowledgement that you are their top priority because you (as a client) are the lifeblood of their business? There is a huge difference in these approaches, and the latter builds loyalty and trust which is vital to the health of any business.


You are solution\-oriented and accountable. When given an opportunity to address an issue you follow service standards and quickly provide a solution, if you can't you are able to escalate the issue and alert your manager to your need/want for knowledge and growth \- all while communicating progress in a professional and engaging manner with the client.


Part of our team! While service tickets are addressed individually our crew is always ready to support one another, you will both receive and provide help as we are all working toward the same goal. Together we provide a level of service that our clients dream of and that we stand behind.

  

**Project Coordinator Summary**


As the Project Coordinator, you will work under the direction of the Project Manager to assist with a variety of administrative tasks and oversee multiple projects. You will also help to ensure that tasks and tickets are completed on time, and maintain communication with clients, vendors, and technicians regarding scope of work and project timelines.


**Ideal Candidate Profile: Project Coordinator**  

The ideal candidate for the Project Coordinator role is highly organized, proactive, and comfortable managing a high volume of moving pieces in a fast\-paced environment. This person does not need to be technical, but they do need to be highly dependable with communication, follow\-up, documentation, and ownership of next steps.  

This role is best suited for someone who can bring structure, consistency, and accountability to a busy project environment. The strongest candidate will be someone who understands that successful project coordination depends heavily on clear client communication, timely follow\-through, and making sure no task, update, or commitment falls through the cracks.  

  

**Preferred Experience**  

The strongest candidate will have prior experience in project coordination, operations coordination, scheduling, client coordination, account coordination, or a similar role where they were responsible for keeping multiple workstreams organized and on track.  

Experience in an MSP, IT, or professional services environment is a plus, but not required. More important than industry\-specific experience is the ability to communicate clearly, manage follow\-up, track open items, prioritize effectively, and stay organized when timelines or expectations shift.  

The ideal candidate should have experience supporting multiple concurrent projects, tasks, or client requests at one time. They should be able to demonstrate that they have successfully managed competing priorities in a fast\-paced environment where client communication, follow\-through, and attention to detail were critical.  

  

**Key Responsibilities**  

The Project Coordinator will work under the direction of the Project Manager to help coordinate multiple active projects at one time. This role is responsible for tracking project\-related tasks and tickets, coordinating schedules, communicating with clients and vendors, and helping ensure timelines and expectations remain clear.  

  

**Responsibilities include:**


* Communicate clearly and proactively with clients regarding scope, scheduling, timelines, updates, and next steps


* Follow up consistently on open items, pending responses, delayed tasks, and outstanding action items


* Track and follow up on project tasks, tickets, timelines, and commitments


* Ensure client communications are timely, professional, accurate, and client\-friendly


* Coordinate internal scheduling for project\-related work, including onsite and remote work


* Communicate with vendors regarding scheduling, timelines, deliverables, and project\-related needs


* Respond to client questions and requests in a timely and professional manner


* Help manage client expectations and escalate concerns, delays, blockers, or timeline risks appropriately


* Coordinate with internal teams, project resources, vendors, procurement, and installation resources


* Collaborate with Procurement to monitor the status and timing of ordered parts or equipment


* Coordinate travel for Installation Technicians when required


* Assist with creating and updating internal processes, policies, and procedures


* Handle sensitive information with confidentiality and professionalism


* Support training for Project team members and new hires as needed

**ABOUT SOUTRON GLOBAL**
========================


Soutron Global builds the technology that libraries, archives, and museums run on. Our public library portfolio includes Apollo, the cloud\-native integrated library system (ILS) trusted by roughly 1,000 smaller public libraries with approximately 99% logo retention; VERSO, our ILS for mid\-size public libraries and consortia; and SHAREit, the resource\-sharing and interlibrary loan network that connects libraries across states and regions. Apollo joined Soutron in July 2026\. Soutron Global is backed by Bloom Equity Partners.**ABOUT THE ROLE**
==================


This is the first dedicated customer success seat on Soutron’s public library base — well over a thousand library locations, most of them small, all of them running software they genuinely like. Logo retention on Apollo is approximately 99%.  

**So this is not a churn job.** It is a reach\-and\-engagement job. The single biggest constraint on this base is not risk; it is that nobody is talking to it. Our customers are librarians in small public libraries, and they are already talking to each other constantly — in Facebook groups, on state library association listservs and forums, in ALA and PLA communities, and at state conferences. Your job is to be present and useful in those places, run programs that reach the whole base at once, and turn that engagement into adoption and module attach.  

**You will own product lines, not an account list.** You are the person the Apollo and VERSO communities know by name — the one who runs the release walkthroughs, answers the question in the group thread, hosts the office hours, and knows which library solved the problem the next library is about to ask about.  

**What this role is not:** it is not a named\-account enterprise CSM seat, and it does not carry renewal administration or renewal forecasting — those sit with Renewals and Sales Operations. * Run a standing program calendar: release walkthroughs, office hours, feature clinics, and peer showcases.
* Surface and connect customers to each other. Peer proof moves this market more than anything we say ourselves.
* Develop references, case studies, and advocates in partnership with Marketing.

**Product Expertise and Advocacy**
----------------------------------

* Be the customer\-facing owner for your assigned product line or lines — the person the base knows by name and the internal person who knows the base best.
* Know your product properly: not just what it does, but how a librarian uses it on a Tuesday morning.
* Own release communication and education for your product line end to end.
* Represent your line internally to Product, Support, and Engineering with evidence rather than anecdote.

* Use automation deliberately, so coverage does not scale with headcount.
* Kill programs that do not work and say why.

**Adoption and module attach — the commercial outcome**

new_jobs.title: Customer Success Manager, Corporate
new_jobs.description:
### **About the role:**


Corporate Customer Success Managers are the reason PetDesk retains and grows its largest customer segment, protecting revenue across a portfolio of 500\+ corporate accounts through proactive success management.

This role builds and executes plans that drive adoption, monitors account health to proactively identify risk, and intervenes before issues threaten retention. The Corp CSM serves as the voice of the customer internally and among executive external leadership; they surface expansion opportunities, partner with Marketing to generate case studies and referrals, and drive enablement training that helps clinics realize the full value of the platform.

As the primary relationship owner for their portfolio, the Corp CSM builds consultative, trusted\-advisor relationships at the clinic and corporate level, delivers webinars and regional business reviews that translate account data into a clear value narrative, and manages a high volume of relationships with the rigor of a much smaller book. They live PetDesk's value of customer excellence daily, keeping the customer at the center of every decision, even at scale.
### **Apply if you're excited to:**


* Partner strategically with the Strategic Account Manager (SAM), corporate stakeholders, and clinic\-level teams to drive retention and customer value
* Support corporate and regional initiatives, translate enterprise priorities into clinic\-level action, using account health data to identify opportunities to strengthen adoption, engagement, and overall impact
* Surface expansion and upsell signals to the Strategic Account Manager team, directly contributing to revenue growth across your portfolio
* Partner with Marketing to develop case studies and generate referrals that fuel new business
* Design and deliver enablement training that turns product adoption into measurable clinic outcomes
* Identify at\-risk accounts early and drive mitigation plans that protect retention before issues escalate to corporate leadership
* Represent the voice of the customer internally, translating frontline trends into feedback that shapes Support, Product, and Marketing priorities
* Deliver regional webinars and business reviews that turn account metrics into a compelling value story for clinic owners and managers
* Travel up to 25% to build and deepen regional customer relationships
### **About you:**

* 3\+ years in a Customer Success role, ideally managing a large, diverse portfolio of accounts (veterinary industry experience a plus)
* Track record of using account health data to prioritize proactively rather than reactively
* Comfortable identifying expansion opportunities and partnering cross\-functionally with Sales/Account Management to close them
* Confident and polished presenting to groups — experienced delivering webinars or business reviews that land with a non\-technical audience
* Skilled at translating data into a clear, business\-relevant narrative for both customers and internal stakeholders
* Tactful and poised under pressure; thrives in cross\-functional collaboration and fast\-moving environments
* Experience with Salesforce, ChurnZero, or similar CS/automation tools a plus

### **Benefits \& Perks:**

* Medical coverage for employees and dependents (80\-90% covered by employer)
* Employer HSA contribution with HDHP
* 401(k) match up to 3\.5%
* Dependent Care Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
* Dental \& Vision coverage available
* Basic Life and AD\&D Insurance
* Short and Long Term Disability
* Flexible Time Off \& 12 Paid Annual Holidays
* Paid Parental Leave
* Pawternity Leave, Financial Pet Adoption Support \& Subsidized Pet Insurance
* $250 Annual Stipend for Learning and Development

We believe great work should be recognized and rewarded. Our compensation is grounded in industry data and designed to be competitive, transparent, and performance\-driven. Rather than relying on automatic annual increases, we invest in the people making the biggest impact—creating meaningful opportunities for growth as you grow with us.

**Performance Bonus:** In addition to the hourly base pay of $26–$28/hour, this role is eligible for a performance\-based bonus tied to achieving specific, predetermined KPIs and individual performance goals.

PetDesk combines the industry's most user\-friendly client engagement tools with the highest\-rated pet parent app to simplify your veterinary clinic’s operations while strengthening client relationships.



Our recruiting process is rooted in “Who: The A Method of Hiring” and consists of an average 2\-week hiring timeline. This standardized interview process allows candidates to answer the same questions, experience the same process, and ensure a fair performance review from multiple perspectives.



Please, no external recruiters—candidate profiles submitted from external recruiting agencies will not be considered.



We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

**The Company**

We build the machines that power industry. We are Hitachi Global Air Power, a leading global industrial compressed air manufacturer driving the innovations that keep the world moving.
 

From our headquarters in Michigan City, Indiana, our compressed air solutions power manufacturing operations all around the globe; from food and beverage to life\-saving pharmaceuticals and cutting\-edge semiconductor chips. Our portable compressors provide the air power to build roads and bridges, lay pipelines and aid in oil and gas mining and production.
 

We are a team of innovators, engineers, and quality experts with a shared vision to create the next generation of efficient, environment\-forward compressed air solutions that meet the demands of today, while boldly contributing to a sustainable, circular economy. With more than 60 years of legacy and trusted performance through our brands \- Hitachi, Sullair, and Champion (Australia), we are proud of our reputation for reliability, durability, and performance and groundbreaking engineering.
 

Join us in building a future where your work has an impact. At Hitachi Global Air Power, you’ll be part of a global network that’s shaping the future of industrial power.


**Summary of the position:**

The Sales Enablement Specialist will play a crucial role in enhancing our sales organization’s effectiveness. You will be responsible for equipping the sales team with the tools, resources, and training they need to effectively sell our products and services. This role requires a strategic thinker with excellent communication skills and a deep understanding of sales processes. You will work closely with sales, marketing, and product management teams to ensure alignment and drive sales effectiveness.

* Voice of the Field : Facilitate the feedback loop between the field and the factory, providing Voice of Customer (VoC) and Voice of Distributor insights to the Innovation / Product Management teams.

new_jobs.title: Mental Health Coach Supervisor
new_jobs.description:
**Join Us in Transforming Youth Mental Health!**



Are you a licensed mental health clinician who gets energized by mentorship, remote work \& enhancing quality of care?



Do you want your experience to reach far more young people than any one caseload ever could? So do we.


**About Us:**



Clayful, an early\-stage EdTech startup, is a mission\-driven team of educators, coaches, and education tech experts dedicated to tackling the youth mental wellness crisis. Our goal: provide every 5\-12th grade student in the U.S. with accessible, immediate, and transformative mental health support


**A High\-level Overview of the Role**


* Clayful is seeking licensed mental health professionals to supervise and develop trained mental wellness coaches who support young people (grades 5–12\) via chat\-based and audio/video coaching sessions.
* This is a part time 1099 contract position
* Supervisors support during and after school hours (5am\-10pm PT). We are looking for evening shift coverage 6\-10 pm PT and/or 2\-6 pm PT.
* Most supervisors work M\-F 20\-25 hours per week, but there is flexibility with your schedule
* You will manage multiple tech platforms to perform your job, so being tech savvy is essential.
* $30/hour with growth opportunity

  


**The Role**



You'll be the steady presence behind the coaches — the person they reach for when a conversation gets heavy, and the person who helps them get sharper over time. Coaching builds skills for right now and what's ahead; your job is to make sure every coach does that well, safely, and within scope.



To be explicit: Clayful supervisors do not provide therapy or clinical treatment to students. You support coaches, safeguard the boundaries of the coaching model, and escalate when a situation calls for more than coaching can offer.


**What You'll Do**


* Provide live support to coaches on shift — answer questions, provide coaching direction \& consult in real time when a conversation escalates
* Review chat and session transcripts against Clayful's coach quality rubric and deliver feedback that's specific, direct, and usable
* Manage coaches alongside the Coach Success Lead — review time sheets and ensure coaches are following necessary policies \& operations while maintaining excellent coach quality
* Surface patterns across sessions that should shape coach training, cheat sheets, and program content
* Send personalized follow up messages to Clayful users to drive engagement


*Coach Supervisor Testimonial: I’m incredibly grateful for the people I’ve met here and for everything Clayful has taught me about leadership, humility, teamwork, and what it truly means to show up for young people. The support, compassion, and understanding I received from this community during some of the biggest and at times, heaviest moments of my life mean more to me than I can put into words.*


**What You'll Need**



* **Licensed** in a mental health related field, social work or counseling.


* **4 years experience in the mental health field** — including supervising, mentoring, or coaching other practitioners


* **Direct experience with youth —** including risk assessment, safety planning, and mandated reporting


* **Tech savviness —** ability to multi\-task, make decisions under pressure, learn new technology tools \& work in a text\-based remote environment.


* Reliable laptop or desktop and internet (50\+ Mbps download)


* A private, distraction\-free workspace


* Must reside and remain in the U.S. for the duration of the contract



**Who Thrives Here**



You give feedback that's honest and kind at the same time, and you hold a quality bar without making it punitive.



You stay calm when a coach doesn't, having the ability to handle crisis situations with ease.



You’re tech\-savvy and a quick learner. You'll be supporting Coaches on multiple online platforms, so you need to be able to navigate them with confidence.



We’re an early\-stage startup – things can change quickly! We need a Coach Supervisor who is flexible, embraces change \& enjoys collaboration.



You’re organized and efficient. You know how to multitask successfully and prioritize your work.



You are mission\-driven \& care about young people’s mental health. You’re excited and inspired by working every day to bring mental wellness to students around the world.


**Application Process**



* Written application with license verification


* Video interview


* Live scenario exercise


* Two references, including one from someone you've supervised or mentored


* Background check



**Ready to Make a Difference?**



Join us in this groundbreaking, impactful work. Apply today to become a Clayful Coach Supervisor and help transform youth mental health!

new_jobs.title: Billing Operations Associate
new_jobs.description:
**We're transforming the grocery industry**



At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.



Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.


**Instacart is a Flex First team**

There’s no one\-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in\-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

### **This is a remote role that may be performed from any U.S. State except California, Connecticut, New Jersey, New York, and Washington.**


**Why this role is on the menu**
--------------------------------



The Billing Operations Associate owns the end\-to\-end billing lifecycle across Instacart's retail partner portfolio, ensuring accurate invoicing, timely month\-end close, and compliance with financial controls.

  



The ideal candidate thrives in a fast\-paced operational environment, takes ownership of their work, and is committed to delivering high\-quality, accurate results consistently.

  


**What you'll cook up in your first year**
------------------------------------------


* Monthly billing cycles are executed accurately and on time, with invoices calculated, generated, and delivered via email and third\-party portals such as Ariba.
* Credit memos, debit memos, and refunds are processed in accordance with approved requests.
* Oracle workbooks are built and maintained for new and amended contracts.
* Commercial contracts are reviewed to identify billing requirements, with billing language validated with senior team members as needed.
* Peer reviews of invoice calculations are completed to ensure accuracy and adherence to contract terms.
* Billing inquiries are responded to promptly, with complex disputes escalated appropriately.
* Audit requests are supported and ad hoc projects are completed accurately and on time.
* Established SOPs and internal controls are followed to ensure consistent and compliant billing operations.

  


**The secret ingredients we're looking for**
--------------------------------------------


**Must\-have pantry staples (Minimum Qualifications)**


* 2\+ years of experience in billing operations, accounts receivable, order\-to\-cash, or a similar role, preferably in a a B2B tech, marketplace, or SaaS environment
* Foundational understanding of invoicing processes, ERP workflows, and AR fundamentals
* Strong attention to detail with the ability to manage high\-volume workloads accurately
* Expert proficiency with spreadsheets (Google Sheets, Microsoft Excel)
* Familiarity with Oracle or similar ERP systems
* Familiarity with Salesforce or similar CRM
* Clear and professional communication skills with the ability to work cross\-functionally
* Ability to follow defined processes and controls while knowing when to escalate
* Self\-starter who takes ownership and delivers on commitments

  


**Optional garnishes (Preferred Qualifications)**


* Experience with BI or data tools such as Alteryx or SQL
* Experience or aptitude to leverage AI tooling to augment or automate processes
* Familiarity with marketplace, subscription, or advertising billing models
* Exposure to working with Finance, Legal, or Sales teams in a cross\-functional capacity
